strings.ru: У меня есть плотина по дороге, но при этом всего одна повозка. А эти разбойники не позволят мне бродить беспрепятственно!

strings.en: My dogs can help you there. Grip! Fang! Wolf! Stay!
strings.ru: Мои собаки могут помочь вам. Клык! Хват! Волк! Сидеть!

strings.en: So much gone, those buggers! But least we won't go hungry. I'd really like to have my dogs teach them a thing or two.
strings.ru: Сколько всего пропало, вот же бестолковые негодяи! Но, по крайней мере, мы не будем голодать. Я бы очень хотел, чтобы мои собаки научили их кое-чему.

strings.en:
Farmer Maggot: That'll teach them! My friends, I would be lost without you. If ever you come down to the borderlands, 
 don't hesitate to come knocking. Tea and mushrooms will always be ready for you!
strings.ru:
Фермер Мэггот: Это их научит! Друзья мои, без вас я бы пропал. Если вы когда-нибудь будете в пограничных землях,
не стесняйтесь стучаться. Чай и грибы всегда будут готовы для вас!

strings.en: Help me! These gurt buggers are trying to burn me farm!
strings.ru: Помогите! Эти проходимцы пытаются сжечь мою ферму!

strings.en: Agh! Help! These ruffians are destroying me cart!
strings.ru: Ах! Помогите! Разбойники ломают мою тележку!

strings.en: Keep me safe while I put out the last of these fires!
strings.ru: Охраняйте меня, пока я тушу последний пожар!

strings.en: I'll need to go back for more water!
These fires will spread if we don't put them out soon!
strings.ru: Огонь будет распространяться, если мы не потушим его в ближайшее время!

strings.en: No! Me precious hounds! You buggers will pay for that!
strings.ru: Нет! Мои драгоценные гончие! Вы, ублюдки, заплатите за это!

strings.en: Gorg: Clever elfs and man not so clever after all!
strings.ru: Горг: Эльфы и человек не так уж и умны в конце концов!

strings.en: YOU WERE BORN OUT OF YOUR MOTHER'S JAMBAGS!
You are two elfs, but look like one elf!
strings.ru: Два эльфа, но выглядят как один!Что еще за эльфская магия?!

strings.en: I IS GREATEST TROLL OF TROLLY-SHAWS!
This barrow was once the tranquil resting place of kings.
strings.ru: Этот курган был когда-то местом упокоения королей.

strings.en: Now, it is the domain of Cargast.
Your attempts to overthrow me are feeble and pathetic.
strings.ru: Ваши попытки одолеть меня слабы и жалки.

strings.en: You cannot stop what has been set in motion here!
My minions will take care of you!
You will join me! Living or dead!
strings.ru: Вы присоединитесь ко мне! Живыми или мертвыми!

strings.en: Who enters the domain of Cargast...
strings.ru: Вы, кто вторгся во владения Каргаста...

strings.en: You think yourself victorious... they will return...
strings.ru: Вы думаете, что победили... они вернутся...

strings.en: A temporary reprieve... the dead do not waver...
I await you... within the King's Chamber...
strings.ru: Я жду вас... в Чертоге короля...

strings.en: Your friends do not have long, Ranger...
Golfimbul: You are brave, but foolish! This place will be your grave! My orcs will feast on your remains!
strings.ru: ГОЛЬФИМБУЛ: Ты храбр, но глуп! Это место станет твоей могилой! Мои орки будут пировать на твоих останках!
Аргх! Орки, убейте этих незваных гостей!

strings.en: Futile! Pathetic! Your puny band cannot stop Golfimbul's horde!
strings.ru: Жалкие ничтожества! Вашему хилому сброду не остановить орду Гольфимбула!

strings.en: The lands of Eriador cannot withstand the growing Shadow!
strings.ru: Земли Эриадора не смогут противостоять растущей Тени!

strings.en: Argh! Enough! Slay them, my warriors!
The Great Eye's plans will not be undone so easily!
strings.ru: Замысел Великого Ока не так просто разрушить!

strings.en: Frodo: Bilbo once told me... his part in this tale would end... that each of us must come and go in the telling
Frodo: Bilbo's story was now over... there would be no more journeys for him... save one.
Bilbo: Tell me again lad... where are we going?

Frodo: To the harbour Bilbo... the elves have accorded you a special honour...
 a place on the last ship to leave Middle-Earth.

Gandalf: Once you are ready, my dear Bilbo, come and see me at the dock. 
 But do not be too hasty, for this is an adventure that neither you nor I shall return from.
Ereinion Gil-galad; Last High King of the Noldor.

Gil-galad was an elven-king.
 Of him the harpers sadly sing;

the last whose realm was fair and free,
 between the Mountains and the Sea.

His sword was long, his lance was keen.
 His shining helm afar was seen;

the countless stars of heaven's field,
 were mirrored in his silver shield.

But long ago he rode away,
 and where he dwelleth none can say;

for into darkness fell his star,
 in Mordor where the shadows are.

It brightens my spirit to see you, Frodo. Word of your bravery and sacrifice has reached far.
 I hope the end of your journey will bring you peace.
Your aid proved invaluable, Gildor Inglorion. Middle-earth owes you a great debt.
Think nothing of it, my friends. May the light of Telperion ever illuminate your paths.
What does it say, mister Frodo?
It is a stone commemorating the first arrival of the Men of Westernesse in Middle-earth, in the year 600 of the Second Age.
Veantur was their captain's name. Their ship was Entulesse.
Look at that tree... how old do you think it is?
I wonder if a Took has ever walked these paths before...
It's like we're the only ones left in the world.
Listen, I can hear the birds.
I never thought I'd see the sea Mr Frodo.
Look at those flowers, they're still blooming even though there's no one to see them.
It appears their time has ended...
Frodo... any chance of seeing that old ring of mine again? The one I gave you.
Sorry, Uncle... I'm afraid I lost it
Should like to have held it one last time.
Bilbo: Oh! Well, here's a sight I have never seen before.
Aragorn must stand close to heroes until they have finished talking.
strings.ru: Арагорн должен стоять рядом с героями, пока они не закончат говорить.

strings.en: A fell host approaches. They bear the White Hand of Isengard.
strings.ru: Приближается падшее воинство. Они несут метку Сарумана — Белую Длань.

strings.en: What I would not give for a few dozen armourers from the Iron Hills. The Men of Rohan are brave, yes... but their craftsmanship is lacking.
strings.ru: Что бы я только не отдал за несколько дюжин оружейников из Железных холмов. Люди Рохана храбры, да... но мастерства им не достает.

strings.en: Lord Aragorn... seeing you alive after all gladdens my heart. Your presence here inspires the people.
strings.ru: Лорд Арагорн... я так рада видеть вас живым. Ваше присутствие вдохновляет мой народ.

strings.en: Morale is low... let us hope that we may find our courage.
strings.ru: Моральный дух роханцев иссякает с каждым часом... будем надеяться, что мы найдем в себе силы оставаться мужественными.

strings.en: It seems to me that the doom of our people is near at hand. We will not live out the night.
strings.ru: Кажется мне, что гибель нашего народа близка. Нам не пережить эту ночь.

strings.en: Where is the horse and the rider? Where is the horn that was blowing?
strings.ru: Где конь и всадник? Где рог звенящий?

strings.en: They have passed like rain on the mountains. Like wind in the meadow.
strings.ru: Они прошли, как дождь в горах. Как ветер на лугу.

strings.en: The days have gone down in the West. Behind the hills, into shadow.
strings.ru: Сгинули дни былые в закатной тени за холмами.

strings.en: How did it come to this?
They come to destroy the world of Men.
strings.ru: Они прибыли, чтобы уничтожить мир людей.

strings.en: Few can match the skill of the Dwarves, my friend.
strings.ru: Немногие могут сравниться с мастерством гномов, мой друг.

strings.en: This is not the end, my friend. Dawn will come.
strings.ru: Это не конец, друг мой. Рассвет придет.

strings.en: Hold onto your courage, my friend. There is always hope.
strings.ru: Сохраняйте мужество, друг мой. Всегда есть надежда.

strings.en: They have passed like rain on the mountains. Like wind in the meadow..
strings.ru: Они прошли, как дождь на горах. Как ветер на лугу.

strings.en: Soldiers of Rohan! Make your way to the armory. We must do all we can to prepare.
strings.ru: Солдаты Рохана! Направляйтесь в оружейную. Мы должны сделать все возможное, чтобы встретить врага!

strings.en: To the armory, archers! The Enemy comes, and we must be ready!
strings.ru: В оружейную, лучники! Враг идет, и мы должны быть готовы!

strings.en: Brave Men of Rohan! Go to the armory, where bright mail and spear await! All must be ready to defend the Hornburg!
strings.ru: Храбрые люди Рохана! Идите в оружейную, где вас ждут блестящие доспехи и копья! Все должны быть подготовлены к защите Хорнбурга!

strings.en: Eomer: You were amongst the ranks of the Enemy. Yet you did not fight.
strings.ru: Эркенбранд: Ты был в рядах врага. Но ты не сражался.

strings.en: Eomer: We are not savage men that would murder prisoners of war.
strings.ru: Эркенбранд: Мы не варвары, чтобы убивать военнопленных.

strings.en: Wulfgar: I had no choice but to pledge myself to Saruman's cause.
strings.ru: Вульфгар: У меня не было иного выбора, кроме как поклясться в верности Саруману.

strings.en: Wulfgar: Nor the wrath of the King of Rohan.
strings.ru: Вульфгар: И даже гнев Теодена меня так не страшит.

strings.en: Gandalf: Few can withstand the fell Voice of Saruman.
strings.ru: Гэндальф: Немногие могут сопротивляться зловещему голосу Сарумана.

strings.en:
Theoden: This battle is over. You will aid in the burying of the dead, and in the repair of this 
 fortress. After this, you will cross the Isen, never to return bearing arms.
strings.ru:
Теоден: Эта битва окончена. Вы поможете похоронить мертвых и отремонтировать эту
крепость. После чего вы пересечете Изен и никогда не вернетесь с оружием в руках.

strings.en: Guard: Halt! You approach the gates of the King of Rohan. Make yourself known.

Halbarad: Halbarad Dunadan, Ranger of the North I am. We seek one Aragorn, 
 son of Arathorn, and we heard he was in Rohan...
strings.ru:
Я Хальбарад Дунэдайн, следопыт Севера. Мы ищем Арагорна,
сына Араторна, и слышали, что он в Рохане...

strings.en:
Halbarad: I have thirty rangers with me. That is all of our kindred that could be gathered in haste; but the brethren Elladan
 and Elrohir have ridden with us, desiring to go to the war. We rode as swiftly as we might when your summons came.
strings.ru:
Хальбарад: Со мной тридцать следопытов — это все, кого удалось собрать в спешке. Также братья Элладан
и Элрохир прибыли с нами, желая отправиться на войну. Мы мчали так быстро, как только могли, услышав твой призыв.

strings.en:
Halbarad: This is a gift that I bring you from the Lady of Rivendell. She wrought it in secret, and long was the making. But she also sends
 word to you: The days now are short. Either our hope cometh, or all hopes end. Therefore I send thee what I have made for thee. 
 Fare well, Elfstone!
strings.ru:
Хальбарад: Вот дар, который передала тебе леди Ривенделла. Она тайно изготавливала его в течение долгого времени. Она также передает
тебе следующие слова: "Дни стремительно ускользают. Либо вспыхнет наша надежда, либо наступит ее закат. Поэтому я отправляю тебе то, что предназначено именно для тебя.
Береги себя, Эстель!"

strings.en: Aragorn: And you have found him! Of all joys this is the least expected!
strings.ru: Арагорн: И вы его нашли! Из всех радостей — эта самая неожиданная!

strings.en:
Aragorn: But I did not summon you, save only in wish. My thoughts have often turned to you, 
 and seldom more than tonight; yet I have sent no word...
strings.ru:
Арагорн: Но я не призывал вас, разве что мысленно. Мои думы часто обращались к вам,
особенно этой ночью, но я не посылал ни слова...

strings.en:
Aragorn: Always my days have seemed to me too short to achieve my desire. 
 But great indeed will be my haste ere I take that road.
strings.ru:
Арагорн: Слишком короткими казались мне дни, чтобы выполнить желаемое.
И велика будет моя спешка, когда я вступлю на эту тропу.

strings.en: Aragorn: Now I understand your purpose. Bear this standard for me a while longer. We must ride out soon.
strings.ru: Арагорн: Теперь я осознаю вашу цель. Несите это знамя для меня еще некоторое время. Мы должны отправиться скоро.

strings.en:
Elrohir: I bring word to you from my father: The days are short. 
 If thou art in haste, remember the Paths of the Dead.
strings.ru:
Элрохир: Я принес тебе весть от моего отца: "Дни коротки".
Если ты спешишь, помни о Тропе мертвых.

strings.en: Haldir: Elen sila lumenn omentielvo, Elrondyn. It gladdens my heart to hear the message you have delivered.
strings.ru: Халдир: Elen sila lumenn omentielvo, Elrondyn. Мое сердце радо слышать доставленное тобой послание.

strings.en: Elladan: Well met, Haldir of Lorien. We have heard stories of the brave marchwardens of the Golden Wood.
strings.ru: Элладан: Приветствую тебя, Халдир из Лориэна. Мы слышали рассказы о храбрых стражах Золотого Леса.

strings.en: Elrohir: It has been many years since we have walked the paths of Caras Galadhon.
strings.ru: Элрохир: Прошло много лет с тех пор, как мы ходили по тропам Карас Галадона.

strings.en:
Haldir: Those of my warriors that have survived this battle will return north soon, 
 where they will guard our fences against the Enemy.
strings.ru:
Халдир: Те из моих воинов, что выжили в этой битве, вскоре вернутся на север,
где будут охранять наши границы от врага.

strings.en:
Haldir: But my heart beckons me to pledge myself to your company. 
 I wish to ride with Elessar, and fight by his side.
strings.ru:
Халдир: Но мое сердце подсказывает мне, что я должен остаться с вами.
Я хочу присоединиться к Элессару в его походе.

strings.en: Do not leave the Deeping Wall!
If we abandon the Deeping Wall, the battle is lost!
strings.ru: Если мы оставим крепостную стену, битва будет проиграна!

strings.en: We cannot surrender the Deeping Wall!
strings.ru: Мы не можем сдать крепостную стену!

strings.en: The Deeping Wall will be overrun in:
strings.ru: Стена Хельмовой пади будет захвачена через:

strings.en: Move Aragorn to the battlements once you have finished your preparations.
strings.ru: Отправьте Арагорна на крепостную стену, как только закончите все приготовления.

strings.en: The Galadhrim must defend the Deeping Wall while the Men of Rohan defend their Keep.
strings.ru: Отправить галадрим на крепостную стену, а роханских лучников на стены Хорнбурга.

strings.en: Galadhrim in the Hornburg will move to the Deeping Wall once the Uruk-hai arrive.
strings.ru: Галадрим в Хорнбурге перейдут на крепостную стену, когда прибудут урук-хай.

strings.en: Rohirrim in the Deeping-coomb will move to the Hornburg once the Uruk-hai arrive.
strings.ru: Рохиррим из долины Хельмовой пади перейдут в Хорнбург, когда прибудут урук-хай.

strings.en: The Uruk-hai are moving up the causeway.
The main gate is under attack.
The main gate is almost destroyed.
Peasants can repair the main gate.
The Uruk-hai are attempting to deploy mines at the Deeping Wall.
strings.ru: Урук-хай пытаются установить мины у водостока!

strings.en: The Uruk-hai have deployed a mine in the culvert. Stop all Torchbearers from igniting them.
strings.ru: Урук-хай установили мину в водостоке. Не дайте факельщикам поджечь ее!

strings.en: Kill Torchbearers before they reach the Deeping Wall.
strings.ru: Убивайте факельщиков до того, как они достигнут крепостной стены!

strings.en: Haldir is surrounded on the Deeping Wall. Reach him before he is overwhelmed.
strings.ru: Халдира окружили на крепостной стене. Если не предпринять действий по его спасению, он не выживет.

strings.en: Haldir has lost half his strength.
Haldir will only survive a few more moments.
strings.ru: У Халдира осталось совсем мало здоровья.

strings.en: All Rohan and Elven forces must evacuate the Deeping-coomb before the north gate can be secured.
strings.ru: Все роханские и эльфийские войска необходимо увести из долины Хельмовой пади до того, как северные врата будут заперты.

strings.en: There are still troops in the Deeping-coomb. Pull them back to close the north gate.
strings.ru: В долине все еще остались войска. Прикажите им отступить, после чего северные врата будут заперты.

strings.en: Prepare a defence in the Hornburg.
Reach the main gate and reinforce the defenders.
strings.ru: Добраться до главных ворот и помочь защитникам.

strings.en: Use the postern gates to move heroes onto the causeway.
strings.ru: Воспользоваться боковым проходом ворот, чтобы отправить героев на дамбу.

strings.en: The gate must hold for at least 4 minutes.
strings.ru: Удерживайте ворота Хорнбурга не менее 4 минут.

strings.en: Spear throwers deal heavy damage to battering rams.
Theoden: They come again! To the gate! Draw your swords!
Theoden: Aragorn, take your men to the Causeway! We must push them back!
The Tower of Orthanc can not be felled... leave it be.
Rocks pulled from structures inflict heavier damage.
Burnings ents can be extinguished in pools.
Gandalf has arrived to the South.
Razing Isengard will bring more Ents from Fangorn to aid you.
More Ents from Fangorn have arrived.
Bonus Objective Failed: An ent has been killed.

Call out to hidden ranger units 
 Left click to activate
strings.ru:
Призыв скрытого отряда следопытов
Щелкните левой кнопкой мыши, чтобы активировать

strings.en: Faramir and his Rangers can use the Lure ability to draw in orc patrols.
strings.ru: Фарамир и его следопыты могут использовать способность «Приманка», чтобы привлечь внимание патрулей орков.

strings.en: Orcs and Southrons are weak to attacks from the flank and behind.
strings.ru: Орки и южане слабы к атакам с фланга и тыла.

strings.en: Mordor forces are approaching the Forbidden Pool
strings.ru: Силы Мордора приближаются к Запретному озеру.

strings.en: Tread lightly! If those orcs spot us they will alert Mordor's forces to our whereabouts!
strings.ru: Двигайтесь тихо! Если орки нас заметят, они оповестят войска Мордора о нашем местоположении!

strings.en: Orc lookouts will flee if alerted. If they escape, Mordor will send a larger force to search the area.
strings.ru: Дозорные орков попытаются сбежать, если заметят нас. Если им это удастся, Мордор отправит более крупные силы на наши поиски.

strings.en: Orc lookouts will not investigate lures.
strings.ru: Дозорные орков не будут проверять приманки.

strings.en: Those orcs are trying to escape, stop them before they alert the Mordor host!
strings.ru: Орки пытаются сбежать, остановите их, пока они не оповестили войско Мордора!

strings.en: A lookout has escaped. Escape the area and prepare for the Mordor search party!
strings.ru: Дозорный сбежал. Покиньте эту область и приготовьтесь к прибытию поискового отряда Мордора!

strings.en: A Mordor search party has arrived. We must eliminate them before we are overrun!
strings.ru: Прибыл поисковый отряд Мордора. Мы должны уничтожить их до того, как они перебьют нас!

strings.en: Mordor search party will arrive in:
Madril and Damrod have returned. Meet them at Henneth Annun.
strings.ru: Мадриль и Дамрод вернулись. Встретьтесь с ними в Хеннет-Аннун.

strings.en: Anborn's rangers are camped in the northern woods, while Mablung and his men are trapped in the southern region.
strings.ru: Следопыты Анборна расположились лагерем в северном лесу, а Маблунг и его люди укрылись в южном регионе.

strings.en: There are also a few scattered scouts who we should try and make contact with before they are discovered.
strings.ru: Также в здешних местах укрываются несколько наших разрозненных разведчиков, с которыми мы должны попытаться установить контакт, пока их не обнаружили.

strings.en: Captain Faramir! My rangers and I are at your command!
strings.ru: Капитан Фарамир! Я и мои следопыты в Вашем распоряжении!

strings.en: A most timely arrival, my captain. Command is yours!
strings.ru: Самое своевременное прибытие, мой капитан. Командуйте!

strings.en: Nearby hidden ranger groups can be located by using the Lure ability and listening for a response.
strings.ru: Если отряды следопытов скрыты неподалеку, их можно обнаружить, используя способность «Приманка» и прислушавшись к их ответным действиям.

strings.en: Lead Gollum back to Henneth Annun
Ithilien rangers can now purchase Bodkin arrows and Forged blades
strings.ru: Теперь следопытов Итилиэна можно оснащать заостренными стрелами и коваными клинками

strings.en: We can put up a tent in the clearing at the north end of the Ravine.
strings.ru: Мы можем поставить палатку на поляне в северной части ущелья.

strings.en: We must recruit more rangers if we are going to stand a chance against that convoy.
strings.ru: Мы должны призвать больше следопытов, чтобы у нас была возможность устроить засаду.

strings.en: Place rangers and heroes on defensive stance to lure the convoy into an ambush before attacking.
strings.ru: Выберете для следопытов и героев оборонительную тактику, чтобы заманить конвой в засаду перед атакой

strings.en: Use command S to stop rangers from leaving their positions along the ridges.
strings.ru: Воспользуйтесь быстрой клавишей S, чтобы запретить следопытам покидать свои позиции на возвышенностях.

strings.en: The Harad Convoy has arrived in the South.
Captain Faramir, we have returned with news from the scouts. Follow us to the riverbank.
strings.ru: Капитан Фарамир, мы вернулись с новостями от разведчиков. Следуйте за нами к берегу реки.

strings.en: Madril: Captain Faramir, we have returned with news from the scouts.
strings.ru: Мадриль: Капитан Фарамир, мы вернулись с новостями от разведчиков.

strings.en: Madril: Captain Faramir! The scouts have reported back.
strings.ru: Мадриль: Капитан Фарамир! Разведчики вернулись с донесением.

strings.en: Madril: A great convoy of Haradrim forces has been seen marching up from the Southern borders.
strings.ru: Мадриль: Большая колонна войск харадрим была замечена на подходе к южным границам.

strings.en: Madril: They are likely to reach the eastern pass by tomorrow.
strings.ru: Мадриль: Скорее всего, они достигнут восточного перевала к завтрашнему дню.

strings.en:
Faramir: This is ill news indeed. Already the orcs have doubled their numbers 
 and their patrols have now reached us here in Henneth Annun...
strings.ru:
Фарамир: Это действительно плохие новости. Орки уже удвоили свою численность.
И их патрули скоро настигнут нас здесь, в Хеннет-Аннун...

strings.en: Faramir: If we are to stop this convoy, we must first regroup what men we have left and strike at Mordor's foothold in Ithilien.
strings.ru: Фарамир: Если мы хотим остановить эту колонну, то нам сначала потребуется перегруппировать оставшихся у нас людей и нанести удар по базе Мордора в Итилиэне.

strings.en: Faramir: Get your men some rest, for we must set out at first light.
strings.ru: Фарамир: Пусть твои люди отдохнут, ведь мы должны выдвинуться в путь с первыми лучами солнца.

strings.en: Be wary of their camp men. We cannot risk alerting the guards before we have gathered our full strength.
strings.ru: Опасайтесь людей из их лагеря. Мы не можем рисковать, привлекая внимание стражников, прежде чем соберем все наши силы.

strings.en: We must eliminate all of Mordor's patrols before they discover our secret refuge!
strings.ru: Мы должны уничтожить все патрули Мордора, пока они не обнаружили наше тайное убежище!

strings.en: The enemy will not see us, so long as we keep to the trees and keep a short distance away.
strings.ru: Враг не увидит нас, пока мы прячемся за деревьями и держимся на расстоянии.

strings.en: Should we be spotted, we can lose the enemy by moving into the woods.
strings.ru: Если нас заметят, мы можем оторваться от врага, скрывшись в лесу.

strings.en: We should lure the enemies away and kill them quietly...
strings.ru: Нужно выманивать врагов и убивать их тихо...

strings.en: We will do more damage if we attack from the flank and from behind.
strings.ru: Мы нанесем больше урона, если будем атаковать с фланга и сзади.

strings.en: Madril and Damrod have returned. We should return to the refuge at Henneth Annun.
strings.ru: Мадриль и Дамрод вернулись. Мы должны вернуться в убежище в Хеннет-Аннун.

strings.en: Watch out for that orc lookout!
Those lookouts! will call down a great host upon us should they spot us!
strings.ru: Дозорные! Они приведут с собой большой отряд, если заметят нас!

strings.en: The orc lookouts escaped! We must flee the area and prepare for Mordor reinforcements!
strings.ru: Дозорные орков сбежали! Нам нужно покинуть эту область и готовиться к появлению поискового отряда Мордора!

strings.en: The orcs are burning the trees! Don't let them remove our cover!
strings.ru: Орки жгут деревья! Не дайте им лишить нас укрытия!

strings.en: Even more lookouts have escaped! Retreat to cover!
strings.ru: Сбежал еще один орк-дозорный!! Отступайте в укрытие!

strings.en: Those lookouts will give away our position!
We cannot allow any more orc lookouts to escape!
strings.ru: Мы не можем позволить сбежать ни одному орку-дозорному!

strings.en: Our rangers have reported that Mordor has established a large camp to the north-east.
strings.ru: Наши следопыты доложили, что Мордор разбил большой лагерь на северо-востоке.

strings.en: This is Mordor's staging post for raids into Gondorian territory.
strings.ru: Это перевалочный пункт Мордора для набегов на территорию Гондора.

strings.en: If we destroy this camp the enemy's advance will be slowed!
strings.ru: Если мы уничтожим этот лагерь, продвижение противника замедлится!

strings.en: To strike at Mordor's base we will need the full strength of our forces in Ithilien.
strings.ru: Чтобы нанести удар по базе Мордора, нам понадобится больше следопытов.

strings.en: We must make contact with the other Ranger-captains.
strings.ru: Мы должны связаться с другими капитанами следопытов.

strings.en: Anborn's rangers are camped in the northern woods, while Mablung and his men were sent south.
strings.ru: Следопыты Анборна расположились лагерем в северных лесах, а Маблунг и его люди отправились на юг.

strings.en: There are other rangers hidden throughout the region as well. We should try and find as many as we can.
strings.ru: Также в здешних местах укрываются несколько наших разрозненных разведчиков, с которыми мы должны попытаться установить контакт, пока их не обнаружили.

strings.en: We must find the remaining rangers at Anborn's camp.
strings.ru: Мы должны отыскать оставшихся следопытов в лагере Анборна.

strings.en: We must find the remaining rangers at Mablung's camp.
strings.ru: Мы должны отыскать оставшихся следопытов в лагере Маблунга.

strings.en: The rangers will be hidden from view. Call out to them! They will respond and tell us their location.
strings.ru: Следопыты будут скрыты от глаз. Позовите их! Они откликнутся и сообщат нам о своем местонахождении.

strings.en: There are reports of Lumber mills throughout Ithilien. They're clearing away the trees, and with them, our cover.
strings.ru: Поступают сообщения о лесопилках по всему Итилиэну. Они вырубают деревья, а вместе с ними и наше укрытие.

strings.en: We must take out these Lumber Mills or else we'll soon be battling on a barren plain.
strings.ru: Мы должны разрушить эти лесопилки, иначе вскоре мы будем вынуждены сражаться на бесплодной равнине.

strings.en: Five lumber mills remain, we must destroy them!
strings.ru: Осталось пять лесопилок, мы должны их уничтожить!

strings.en: There are only four lumber mills left
We must destroy the last three lumber mills
strings.ru: Мы должны уничтожить последние три лесопилки

strings.en: There are only two lumber mills remaining
That's the last of their wretched lumber mills!
strings.ru: Это последняя из их жалких лесопилок!

strings.en: A strange creature was spotted on the cliffs to the northeast. We should send captain Anborn there to investigate.
strings.ru: На скалах к северо-востоку было замечено странное существо. Мы должны послать туда капитана Анборна на разведку.

strings.en: The creature Gollum has been captured. Take him back to Henneth Annun. Captain Faramir can question him later.
strings.ru: Существо по имени Голлум схвачено. Отведите его обратно в Хеннет-Аннун. Капитан Фарамир сможет допросить его позже.

strings.en: Well done men! Without their camp, Mordor's forces will be cut off!
strings.ru: Так держать! Без их лагеря силы Мордора будут отрезаны!

strings.en: A great Haradrim host will arrive soon. We must be ready to stop them!
strings.ru: Вскоре прибудет великое войско харадрим. Мы должны быть готовы остановить их!

strings.en: We should stage an ambush and station men along the eastern pass.
strings.ru: Мы должны организовать засаду и расставить людей вдоль восточного перевала.

strings.en: These ridges will hide our men from the enemy and allow us to strike when they are vulnerable.
strings.ru: Эти хребты скроют наших людей от врага и позволят нам нанести удар, когда они будут наиболее уязвимы.

strings.en: We will need a full force to defeat the Haradrim and their Mumakil. We can recruit more rangers from our camp.
strings.ru: Нам понадобятся все силы, чтобы победить харадрим и их мумаков. Мы можем призвать больше следопытов из нашего лагеря.

strings.en: There are still rangers hiding in Ithilien. We should find them before the convoy arrives.
strings.ru: В Итилиэне все еще скрываются следопыты. Мы должны найти их до прибытия конвоя.

strings.en: There are still areas of the ridge unprotected. We should make us of these vantage points quickly!
strings.ru: На хребте все еще есть незащищенные участки. Нам нужно воспользоваться этими точками обзора как можно скорее!

strings.en: The final convoy has arrived! Destroy the last of these foul invaders!
strings.ru: Последний конвой прибыл! Уничтожьте этих мерзких захватчиков до последнего!

strings.en: That's it! The Haradrim force has been destroyed!
strings.ru: Вот и все! Войска харадрим уничтожены!

strings.en: Our scouts report that Sauron has marshalled his army and prepares to invade Gondor.
strings.ru: Наши разведчики докладывают, что Саурон собрал свою армию и готовится к вторжению в Гондор.

strings.en: Orcs are on the move, Southrons have been spotted near our borders. Fair Ithilien will soon be under attack.
strings.ru: Орки в пути, южане замечены у наших границ. Славный Итилиэн скоро подвергнется нападению.

strings.en:
Captain Faramir will direct his most trusted rangers to stall and waylay the enemy. 
 We must destroy the scouting parties before we are discovered.
strings.ru:
Капитан Фарамир направит своих самых надежных следопытов, чтобы задержать и обвести врага вокруг пальца.
Мы должны уничтожить разведчиков до того, как нас обнаружат.

strings.en: The Hall of Records should be close to here...
Indeed. Perhaps there we can find out what happened to Balin and his colony...
strings.ru: В самом деле. Возможно, там мы сможем узнать, что случилось с Балином и его отрядом..

strings.en: Boromir: Hold! We can go no further!
Gandalf: Orcish sorcerors! They weave spells of shadow and flame. We must end their incantations!
Swiftly now! Strike down the sorcerers!
The White City is vast. You may use Waystones to quickly access a previously discovered location.
Use the brandy to distract the guards.
Gandalf: Yes, the White Tree of Gondor. The Tree of the King.
Gandalf: Lord Denethor, however, is not the King.
Gandalf: He is a steward only. A caretaker of the throne.
Pippin: Why are they still guarding it?
Gandalf: They guard it because they have hope.
Gandalf: Faith and fading hope that one day it will flower.
Gandalf: ...and this city will be as it once was...
Gandalf: The old wisdom born out of the West was forsaken.
Gandalf: Kings made tombs more splendid than the houses of the living...
Gandalf: ...and counted the old names of their descent dearer than the names of their sons.
Gandalf: Childless lords sat in aged halls, musing on heraldry...
Gandalf: ...or in high cold towers asking questions of the stars...
Gandalf: ...and so the people of Gondor fell into ruin.
Gandalf: The line of Kings failed...
Gandalf: ...the rule of Gondor was given over to lesser Men.
Gandalf: This city has dwelt ever in the sight of its shadow.
Gandalf: This is not the weather of the world.
Gandalf: This is a device of Sauron's making, a broil of fume he sends ahead of his host.
Gandalf: The orcs of Mordor have no love of daylight...
Gandalf: ...so he covers the face of the sun to ease their passage along the road to war.
Gandalf: When the shadow of Mordor reaches this city...
Boromir: A greater folly it would have been to take it.
Boromir: To my shame, I made the attempt, and by good fate, the Ring of Power was kept from me.
Boromir: Keep to the path of hope, father. No ruin will come to Gondor while its sons defend it.
Denethor: The Ring of Power lay within your grasp! What folly came over you that you let the halfling keep it?
Denethor: What good can it do for Gondor now? Without its power, this war cannot be won.
Denethor: Worse yet, the halfling will surely be caught by Sauron's spies.
Denethor: On its Master's finger, the Ring will bring us to utter ruin!
Gandalf: Lord Denethor is Boromir's father. To give him news of his beloved son's death would be most unwise.

Gandalf:...And do not mention Frodo, and say nothing of Aragorn either.
In fact it's best if you did not speak at all, Peregrin Took.
Gandalf: Hail Denethor, son of Ecthelion, Lord and Steward of Gondor.
Gandalf: I come with tidings in this dark hour, and with council.
Denethor: Perhaps you come to explain this...
Denethor: Perhaps you come to tell me why my son is dead...
Pippin: Boromir died to save us, my kinsman and me.
Pippin: He fell defending us from many foes.
Pippin: I offer you my service, such as it is...
Pippin: In payment of this debt.
Denethor: This is my first command to you.
Denethor: How did you escape and my son did not, so mighty a man as he was?
Pippin: The mightiest man may be slain by one arrow... and Boromir was pierced by many.
Gandalf: There will be a time to grieve for Boromir, but it is not now.
Gandalf: The Enemy is on your doorstep!
Gandalf: As Steward you are charged with the defence of this city... where are Gondor's armies?
Gandalf: You are not alone in this fight.
Denethor: You think you are wise, Mithrandir...
Denethor: Yet for all your subtleties you have not wisdom.
Denethor: Do you think the eyes of the White Tower are blind?
Denethor: I have seen more than you know.

Denethor: With your left hand you would use me as a shield against Mordor...
and with your right you would seek to supplant me.

Denethor: Word has reached my ears of this Aragorn, son of Arathorn,
and I tell you now, I will not bow to this Ranger from the North!
Denethor: Last of a ragged house, long bereft of lordship.
Gandalf: Authority is not given to you to deny the return of the King, Steward!
Denethor: The rule of Gondor is mine! And no other's!
He would even use his grief as a cloak!
A thousand years this city has stood.
Now at the whim of a madman it will fall.
The White Tree, the Tree of the King, will never bloom again.
Boromir: It is a dark fate that has reunited us, son of Paladin. Evil days await the White City.
Pippin: Be that as it may, I am very glad to see you alive and well! You saved my life, and Merry's too.
Pippin: I would like to offer you my service, such as it is, in payment of this debt!
Boromir: The Tower Guard is ever in need of clever warriors such as yourself.
Boromir: Pledge yourself to Gondor, and any debt between us would surely be paid.

Pippin: Here do I swear fealty and service to Gondor. In peace or war, in living or dying,
from this hour henceforth, until my lord release me, or death take me.
Denethor: And I shall not forget it!
Denethor: Nor fail to reward that which is given.
Gandalf: You are a Guard of the Citadel now, Peregrin Took. You will have to do as you're told!
Gandalf: Come and see me once you have familiarised yourself with the duties of your new station. I have urgent matters to attend.
Beregond: Welcome to the ranks of the Citadel Guard, perian. I have been instructed to inform you of your duties.
Beregond: Indeed! Your role is far from ceremonial. A Citadel Guard has many responsibilities he must attend to.
Beregond: You should explore the Seventh Level for a while. There are many important places here for you to discover.
Beregond: At the very least, you should visit the Citadel Barracks, to receive your training and your armour...
Beregond: Once you've done so, come see me at the Gate.
Pippin: Well, looks like I've got some things to take care of!
So, I'm of the Citadel Guard, but judging by your regalia, you're in a different order?
It must be a hard job, standing around here all day.
I stood guard many times myself, when my friend Merry went into Farmer Maggot's crop and... well... nevermind that.
Can I get you something? An apple? Some water? Maybe a pint?
A magnificent silver spike. I wonder which is the tallest, this one, or the ones near the western borders of the Shire?
Leave me to my thoughts, halfling. Grave matters require my attention.
Lord Denethor has long served with wisdom and surety. Through his leadership and foresight we have withstood the legions of Mordor.
Nice to meet you sir. If I may ask, what does a warden of the keys do?
An honourable one, to be certain.

Pippin: Peregrin Took am I, son of Paladin!
I have joined the Citadel Guard of the White City, and have been instructed to explore the Seventh Level by Captain Beregond!

Hallows Guard: Captain Beregond? Beregond is but a guard.
But I have been informed of the arrival of a Halfling Prince from a distant land.
Hallows Guard: That must be you. You may pass. Treat this hallowed place with the veneration it demands.

Pippin: There's so many statues. So many tombs. Pay my respects, Beregond said.
How long has it been since somebody's cleared the moss off of these solemn faces?
Gandalf told me that Gondor has been without a King for many generations. Yet so many of them are laid to rest here. This City is old... older than the Shire, no doubt.
Hy-ar... Hy-ar... Hy-ar-men-dacil. Goodness, what a name. And look! They carved his likeness wearing armour. He must have been a great warrior.
Earnur. The only one without a body. Wonder what happened to him!
A wee tomb... this one tells a story most sad...
Lord Denethor seemed more kingly than any Man I have ever seen, save perhaps Strider when we were in Rivendell. Yet he is only a steward... a protector of the throne.
Dusty old tomes. It appears someone once used this spot for quiet reading.
Mardil Voronwe. It says he was the first of the Ruling Stewards... after King Earnur disappeared...
Here lies Ecthelion the Second... I think this is Lord Denethor's father.
As a Guard of the Citadel, I am expected to practice my swordplay. I have some experience, mind you. It's been a long journey to get here!
I do not doubt it, young sir. But the warriors in this yard are highly skilled. It would be too dangerous, and I have no time now to go over the fundamentals. It would be best if you observed.
As you wish! I'd rather not get beaten bloody. It'll be nice to get a rest anyhow.
Move Pippin onto the spotlight to begin training.

Master-at-Arms: That's how it's done, Halfling! Here is your armour - may it serve you well.
You may return at anytime to observe more practice, should you desire it.
You must complete 5 waves of training to obtain Pippin's armour.
The Master-at-Arms awaits you, friend. Don't keep him waiting!

Beregond: The Fifth Level is open to you, master hobbit. My duties require my attention,
but you may explore at your leisure. For now, at least.
Beregond: No captain am I! I am but a humble guard of the Citadel, same as you.
Pippin: My apologies. Have you seen Gandalf anywhere?
Beregond: Mithrandir has disappeared. I do not know where to. He did not look happy.
Gandalf: Peregrin Took, my lad... There is a task now to be done.
Gandalf: Another opportunity for one of the Shire folk to prove their great worth!
Gandalf: You must light the beacon.
Gandalf: You must not fail me.
Gandalf: The fate of the White City depends upon it.
You mustn't tarry Peregrin Took! That beacon must be lit!
Faramir: Welcome, Master Hobbit. I hear you are to join the Tower Guard.
Pippin: Gandalf told me you've seen Frodo. Was he well?
Faramir: He was. You are his kin?
Pippin: Second-cousin once-removed. What of Samwise?

Faramir: His brave and loyal gardener. He, too, was well.
I have no doubt in his ability to keep his master safe.
Faramir: Go and see the armourer, and tell him that I sent you. He should have a gift for you.

Librarian: 'Fairy-tales of Lamedon', 'King Turambar's Conquest of Rhun', and 'A Tale of Two Kingdoms'.
These have been missing for years. Thank you for returning them.
Librarian: I would reward you, but doing a good deed is its own reward, wouldn't you agree?
Notes, notes, notes… so many notes!
It's a tough job, but somebody has to do it.

Ioreth: You look as if you have stepped right out from an old tale. A halfling prince from a distant land.
Would that I could go there.

Ioreth: No, I should not say such things. My duties are here, in the Houses of Healing, as they have been for many years.
I expect we will be busy soon. War is coming.
Pippin: Is there anything that I might assist you with? You know, to prepare?

Ioreth: There are a great many things that I must see to. We need clean linens. Sheets and bandages, as many as can be found.
The Fuller's on the Third Level should have a batch ready.
Ioreth: I am not as agile as I once was, running through the flowering fields of Imloth Melui. Perhaps you could fetch them?
Here's the linen you requested milady.
Milady? Well, I never! I am but a servant of the warden of this house. Thank you, kind sir. Come visit us again sometime, and tell us a tale or two from your homeland. In good health, of course!
Plants have many uses, both to harm and heal. And sometimes the most unassuming are the most potent. Athelas... its sweet smell soothes those who have seen too much of war...
Dear Shadowfax! How swiftly you carried us! Safely through lands that Gandalf says are no longer safe for gentle folk. I will find you a token of friendship, a reward for your unfaltering service.
Here, my lord - it's not much, but it's the finest apple from the city markets I could find.

Armourer: Captain Faramir has sent word of your coming. It took some work, but I have found the item he wished for you to have.
His helmet, crafted for him by my father, when the captain was still a young boy.
Pippin: I have a large head for a Hobbit, but it looks like it'll fit!
Armourer: Try it on and see.
Pippin: I must look even taller now! I wish I could show my friends.

Boromir: The pledge you have made is a show of great nobility, my friend.
A halfling prince amongst the ranks of the Citadel Guard is a wondrous sight to behold.
Pippin: Thank you. But you know that I'm not really a prince, right?
Boromir: All good tales deserve some embellishment.

Pippin: Boromir... Thank you again for what you did for us. For a long time I thought you had fallen.
Seeing you alive makes me think there is still hope for us.
Boromir: Hope remains, Peregrin Took. I have placed mine in Aragorn, who will join us here in time.
Ah, master Peregrin. There you are!
Harion: Oho, behold! A Halfling, from the verdant Shire!
Alethendir: Certainly! Most folk hereabouts would deem you to have sprung right out of some old Elvish tale.
Harion: But we know better! Cross Calenardhon, now known as Rohan, or the Riddermark...
Alethendir: Westward, until you reach the Isen and cross it at its fords...
Harion: Then north you must journey for many leagues, following the ancient road...
Alethendir: Until you reach Tharbad, the ancient crossing.
Harion: And yet many leagues more, further northward, to the town of Bree, past the ancient tombs of our distant kin.
Alethendir: Then westward you must tread, ever upon the Road, past the ancient forest, until you reach the Baranduin...
Harion: Or Brandywine, as the locals have it...
Both: And lo, you've reached the Shire!
Harion: Yes, there is much to explore in this vast world, but also within these hallowed walls.

Alethendir: Indeed - have you ventured to the topmost levels?
There lies the greatest vantage point to survey the City and the lay of the land.

Harion: We would lend you our spyglass, though we seem to have misplaced it...
Do let us know if you find it amongst your exploits.
That must be the spyglass the cartographers are looking for. I should take it back to them.
What's this? Someone must've misplaced it. Oof, it's heavy! Must be expensive!
Ah, you have returned! Did you happen upon our spyglass?
Thank you kindly! This is quite essential for our work. A token of our appreciation, a map of Minas Tirith. It's the most detailed map you'll find of this city.
Pippin has been given a City Map, which can reveal an area of the map
An apple! I should give it to Shadowfax
Pippin: Hello! Ioreth sent me from the sixth level to collect some fresh linen.

Fuller: Ah yes, for the Houses of Healing? Of course, we have a small bundle here you can take. I'm afraid the rest are still drying,
but I will have one of the porters deliver the remainder before tomorrow.
Pippin: I'm sure she will understand. Thank you!
Here is the clean linen Ioreth has asked me to retrieve.
Where has that darn cat got to... place is crawling w' mice... er oh! What I meant was - we're ship shape alright!
Oh, there you are, my sweet! Thank you, young master! Here, ‘ave a pint on the house!...Err, you are of age, aren't ye?
Say, friend, you wouldn't have any Brandy, would you?
Oh, I think your master's looking for you, little kitten!
'Premium Lossarnach Brandy'... That should take care of that guard!
Veteran: Greetings, perian. From whence do you hail?
Pippin: Me? Oh, I'm from the Shire. I don't suppose you've heard of it. It lies far to the north.
Veteran: I have never travelled north, I fear. My journeys have taken me south... to Umbar.
Veteran: Aye. Nigh on forty years ago, I served under the legendary captain known as Thorongil, the Eagle of the Star.

Veteran: Gondor had long suffered the aggression of the southern corsairs - lawless scum, all -
until our captain undertook a daring raid upon their wretched capital.

Veteran: We burned their black fleet, and Thorongil himself slew the Master of their havens in single combat.
For many years after that, the southrons left our coasts in peace... but now it seems their villainy has resumed.

Veteran: I fear the power of Mordor has emboldened them. If I were still young,
I would venture coastward, and throw them back into the sea...
Pippin: I'm sure you would, master warrior.

Veteran: Hmm. Thank you, perian, for accompanying me today. Here, take this bottle of brandy.
It's from Lossarnach - and quite renowned. Don't go drinking it all at once, now.
I bet I could distract the beacon guard with this...
Oh, thank you. Very kind. Might warm up some old bones with this!
Shoo! You're not going up there, puss!
Beacon Guard: Halt! Passage to the beacons is restricted by the authority of the Steward, even for those among the Citadel Guard.
Beacon Guard 01: The wind's freezing up here. What I wouldn't give for a Lossarnach brandy to warm up these bones.
Beacon Guard 02: I hear the White Swan Inn just got a new shipment of this stuff. Rare these days!
The guards mentioned a certain brandy. I should find the White Swan Inn, and see if I can get a bottle.
The guards mentioned a certain brandy. I should go back to the White Swan Inn, and see if I can get a bottle.
Beacon Guard 01: What's that? Go have a look!
Pippin: I'll just leave this here...
Beacon Guard 02: Is that what I think it is? Keep watch while I warm up!
Pippin: That took care of one of them! I'll just distract the other and quickly get to the beacon.
Bergil: Hello there! I am Bergil, son of Beregond of the Guards. I haven't seen you before. What is your name?
Pippin: I am Pippin of the Shire. I've met your father - I am also of the Guards!
Bergil: You? How old are you? You look much too short to be a guard!
Pippin: I am twenty-nine years of age. And I am rather tall for a Hobbit, I'll have you know.
Bergil: Never heard of a Hobbit before... are you any good at playing hide and seek? I've wanted to play all day.
Bergil: Then come and find me!
Pippin: Very well. I think I can take a break from my duties!
Bergil: Took you long enough! Let's play again!
Bergil: Got me! Not bad, not bad! Let's see if you can find me this time...
Bergil: Come again soon, I beg. I wish there was no war, for we might have had some merry times!

Pippin: Sure, I'll come find you if I've got time... a Guard of the Citadel
has many duties he must attend to, after all. Until then!
Bergil: Farewell for this time! Thank you for your company. Take my greetings to my father!
I met your son Bergil. He sends his greetings!
Did you now? I hope he didn't distract you too much. That boy loves his games.
Surely Bergil hasn't gone this far.
I bet Bergil is hiding somewhere around here.
You are leaving the area in which Bergil is hiding. You can go back to find him, or come back later.
Denethor is beset by some dark despair... a device of Sauron's, I fear.
Word has been sent to the southern fiefs. Imrahil, Forlong... they will fight.
But will it be enough? Their lands are under assault.
He does. We must make way for the return of the King.

Peregrin Took! Eavesdropping, are we!? I hoped you'd have learned a lesson about sticking your nose where it does not belong. Go do as you've been told, and then come see me once you've finished your tasks!
Lord Denethor knows what he is doing... But where is Imrahil? Where are our soldiers?
Every day, the darkness of Mordor draws closer... We have bountiful stores. We will outlast them. Sauron seeks to destroy us, not raid our stores...
We should have bolstered the garrison years ago. Now the hour has grown too late. One Gondorian is worth a score of Mordorian scum. I would not be so sure...

We should have rekindled the old alliances the day Osgiliath was lost. Retaking it was but a temporary reprieve. Why did we not send envoys north? The Elvenking does not gladly dispatch his elves to the aid of Men..

No army has ever breached the Othram. You worry too much. They say Curunir laid low the great wall at Helm's Deep, using some dark sorcery. Who can know what fell devices the Dark Lord himself will send with his armies?
So Mithrandir has returned to the White City. They say doom follows in his footsteps...
I haven't slept for days... and when I do, I dream of the Black Land. Last night I dreamt of a comely maiden amidst the flowers in Imloth Melui.
Lord Denethor is wise, yes, but I  cannot ignore the evidence of my eyes. We need more men. More will come.
You best keep out of trouble...
Some old man in white darn near ran me down this morning.
Ain't no orc that can scale these walls.
By order of the steward...? That's the third one this week...
Little short for a guard aren't ya?
Did you hear? Captain Boromir has returned!
Captain Boromir has been away for many moons... I hope he returns soon.
The eastern sky grows dark... I fear for what is to come.
If you are looking for something, make sure to seek out a notice board.
You are looking for the Citadel Barracks? It lies up ahead, beneath the shadow of the Hall of the Kings.
Gandalf? Ah, Mithrandir. Yes, he passed this way.
You are looking for the White Wizard? I saw him heading west, with some haste!
The finest horse I ever did see. But I doubt even he can resist a shiny red apple from the market...
The White Swan Inn is the finest establishment this side of the Rock.
That sword looks to be of ancient make. Did you get it at the armoury?
Hail, perian. Should you find yourself lost amongst the streets of the city, use these waystones to find your way.
Looking for the Master-at-Arms? He's over there.
Worry not. The White City will not fall
Do not let the threat of Mordor frighten you.
The Men of Gondor have ever stood against the shadow.
You are safe within these walls, perian.
The City is old. It crumbles in places seen and unseen. It's up to us to patch it up.
If you come bearing ill news, I'd rather be spared.
If Osgiliath falls, what are we to do?
Look at him... he's quite short for a prince...
My husband patrols the forests of Ithilien... I hope he is well.
I have stocked up on food... one never knows these days.
The market is plentiful… but for how long?
All my daughter talks about now is the coming arrival of all these fair fiefdom lords...
It's the prince of the Halflings!
Will you help me carry a sack of grain to the granary?
He walked out of the Houses of Healing before the changing of the guard! Now suddenly he can no longer make his bed because he's "injured"...
They've sent my boy to garrison the Rammas Echor... I haven't slept a wink since... Do not despair. Ivorwen tells me Captain Boromir has returned!
The city is getting crowded... Three times they've broken in to take our grain sack. I've asked Ohtar to bolt our windows shut.
...two whole pheasants! As if Lord Forlong himself were coming over for dinner!
...How I long for a stay in a nice cottage in Lossarnach. But it's much too late for that now. The roads are dangerous.
From whence did you snatch that armour, boy? Oh... My apologies.
Do you reckon we're safe here? My mother always said that there is no place as secure as our White City...
All these lords seem to do is talk. We are in need of great deeds, not debate!
Should the time come, will you pick up a blade and fight? Of course. My husband doesn’t know, but I’ve kept my father’s sword secure, and in good condition...
...aye sir, a bit of scrubbing and that blood will come right out no bother
Fine meats for sale! Pheasant and fowl! Salted pork!
Fresh fish for sale! Mussels! Harlond herring! Amroth redfin!
Fruit Seller: Fresh fruit! Ringlo Red apples, sweet and oh so juicy!
Fruit Seller: Here young master, have one! Just don't tell your Ma...
Odo's Oddities! Clangers, whizzbangers, shakers and noise makers! How about you, fine sir?
...wind it up and just like that it'll spring to life! Er... well, it usually does... This one seems to be stuck...
...can't be too careful these days! On the road or on the street, best have a dagger by yer side!
The finest wine from Tolfalas! Rare Dorwinion reds!
Get your apples while we have 'em!
You look like you appreciate the finer things in life.
What are you looking for, halfling?
I have the finest wares in the land.
I supply only the finest goods.
In all my days, never have I seen your kind walk these streets.
What brings you to market today?
War's brewing. Best stock up while you can.
Please don't touch the siege machinery son, that is a dangerous thing!
Well met, halfling! Are you enjoying the sights of the city?
I was sent here to maintain the trade of horses between Rohan and Gondor.
New record number of rounds defeated!
You failed to beat your previous record.

Bilbo: The day of the party is here... I just need to check on a few things...
Bilbo: Ah, I'll ask Frodo. Frodo? FRODO!?
Bilbo: Sticklebacks! Where is that boy?
...The Road goes ever on and on...
Gandalf: A Wizard is never late, Frodo Baggins. Nor is he early. He arrives precisely when he means to!
Frodo: It's wonderful to see you, Gandalf!
Gandalf: You didn't think I'd miss your Uncle Bilbo's birthday?
So, how is the old rascal? I hear it's going to be a party of special magnificence.
You know Bilbo. He's got the whole place in an uproar.
Half the Shire's been invited. And the rest of them are turning up anyway.
He's up to something. And I know you have something to do with it.
Before you came along we Bagginses were very well thought of. Never had any adventures or did anything unexpected.
If you're referring to the incident with the dragon, I was barely involved... all I did was give your uncle a little nudge out of the door.
Frodo: Whatever you did, you've been officially labeled a disturber of the peace.
Children: Gandalf! It's Gandalf! Fireworks, Gandalf! Fireworks!
Run away now! You'll get plenty when the time comes.
Frodo: Gandalf, I'm glad you're back.
Gandalf: So am I, dear boy... so am I.
I should check on some of the preparations. Tonight is the big night, after all.
Frodo: I'm sure those Sackville-Bagginses are abroad. I'd rather not argue... best avoid them!
Otho: So, young Frodo. You must be rather pleased.
Lobelia: You can't keep us out, you upstart. What gives you the right?

Frodo: I don't believe Bilbo intends to keep you out. The messenger service is a bit overwhelmed, that's all.
The invitations may have been lost...
Lobelia: How fortunate - for you! You Bagginses and your luck. Bilbo's sudden wealth, your promotion to his sole heir...
I'll... I'll be on my way now.
Dwarves... they pay no heed to growing things. I keep telling 'em, don't step on the green...
I'm sure you and Sam will be able to mend whatever damage they do.
Mend? Aye, but it may take a few seasons. Perhaps you could remind them?
There's so much food to prepare. And more carts are still coming in!
What's worse, there's Hobbits coming in from all directions, looking to pinch something: apple pies, roasted chickens... one of 'em even appeared dressed as one of my cooks!
I've had to divert a few of mine to scare 'em off, rollers in hand!
It looks like you're still on schedule.
We are - for now. But I see them lingering near the road. Go and shoo them away!
Shoo! You'll eat your fill later!
Off you go! You'll get your chance!
...and that should be the last of those scroungers dealt with. I'm sure Darla will be relieved to hear it.
They're gone. For a while, at least.
Good. They won't go hungry - there'll be plenty tonight. Thank you.
Dwarf-made toys are marvelous creations. Are they magical?
Magical? Aye, I suppose they may be... to you.
Now, don't ask any more, Master Baggins.
Dwarves don't share their secrets. Whether they concern toy-making or gem-cutting, or the brewing of fine ales.
I shan't, my friends. Speaking of Dwarven ale - I see you've brought plenty.
As requested by Master Bilbo. Have a taste.
Oh, the guests will be quite fond of this, I'm sure!
Ah, I've been asked to inform you to please mind the grass and the garden at Bag End. Its keeper takes great pride in his work.
Apologies, Master Baggins. We shall be more careful.
Aye, don't worry, we won't have you chasing dwarves through the Shire.

Master Frodo! Blast that wind! The last of your uncle's invitations have gone fluttering all over Hobbiton. My couriers are all busy as it is - and your uncle's guest list seems to grow by the minute!
I'll see if I can find them.
You will? Oh, bless you, Frodo! That's quite a weight off my mind.
Here they are. One was halfway to Frogmorton before I found it.
Oh, you've found the invitations! I reckon folk'd have turned up anyway, but we can't abandon our duty to the post! Thank you, master Baggins!
Of course. Apologies on behalf of my uncle for the errand he's set you on.
The wind certainly carried these far.
The Postmaster will be pleased to see this.
That should be all of them. I should return them to the Post Officer.
You reckon she'll show up, Mister Frodo?
Oh, Sam. Of course she will.
I'll have to wear my special waistcoat. The one with the shiny buttons...
Oh, I simply cannot wait! I wish the hours would go by quicker!
I do hope Sam will ask me to dance. I think he wanted to last month, at the harvest festival...
Party or no, I don't like the look of these strangers appearing around Hobbiton. Dwarves... I don't trust 'em one bit.
You Bagginses have got queer dispositions, if you ask me. Gallivanting off into the wild. How much treasure has your uncle got hidden away, I wonder?
I'll be on duty, Master Frodo. Around Bywater, that is.
I've got no ill will towards Dwarves, myself. Never gave me any trouble.
You'll save me some, won't you, Master Frodo?
I haven't seen so much busywork 'round these parts, not in all my days
There's Bucklanders afoot! A peculiar folk, to say the least...
I'm half Bucklander myself, mister Noakes. And entirely peculiar!
Oh! Apologies, Master Frodo. I meant no offense.
I think old Bilbo may be up to something. What do you reckon, Frodo?
I do not know! He hasn't told me anything, at least.
What time do you reckon the kegs will be opened?
Ah, Frodo! Looking forward to the party then?
Hiya Frodo! I've been preparing all day for the party.
'ere, I say, there's queer times a-comin'. I heard it from a tree. Oh, no, not that 'un, no, nor him neither, no. Oh... oh, I cannot find it now. Oh, it may have wandered off...
Master Frodo! Have you seen my black goat, Phillip? The cheeky rascal's slipped the fence again.
Not today, did you see where he went?
Toward the Water, last I saw. I'd go me'self, but if I leave this fence half-mended, the rest of my goats'll be after him before long.
I'll see if I can find him.
Here, take these apples. Phillip can't resist 'em. He's stubborn, but toss one in front of his nose and he'll follow you anywhere.
Ah here he is! Thank you Frodo, I'd have been chasing him 'til teatime.
He drove a hard bargain. It cost me a few apples.
A fair price. I'll keep a closer eye on him, though I daresay Phillip has other plans.
There you are. Come along Phillip, here's a nice juicy apple for you.
Ssh! You'll scare away the birds. That one there is a Weymouth Warbler, I think!
I've been lookin' forward to this for days! Weeks!
I skipped second breakfast, just to leave enough room!
Oh, I intend to be among the first upon the field!
I've got work to do, but I can't stop thinking about tonight!
He's always been a bit odd, if you ask me... Oh! err, hi Frodo!
He's always stirring up mischief that Gandalf...
Ah, these potatoes won't dig themselves up.
Bloomin' rabbits got into my cabbages again!
I came out here for something now... what was it?
You're a ways from home, aren't you?
If you're looking for trouble, try the Tooks, heh.
Some folk call it gossip. I call it community awareness.
*The hobbit is too busy drinking and ignores Frodo*
Mind your step, dear! Them squash don't grow themselves.
Hi Frodo! I can't chat now, I 'ave ta set up these tables for later.
Better give the chooks a good feed or they'll be goin hungry!
Someone's been picking blackberries from my hedge, but I have an inkling who.
Mercy me, nine kids! Was this laundry basket ever empty?
I reckon the strawberries were bigger last season.
Oh, don't listen to her. She says that every market day.
I sent him for onions an hour ago. He'll come back with ale.
That lad's always in a hurry. Makes me nervous.
Seven chickens, three children, and a husband who can't find his own socks.
A good pie solves most problems.
The bees have been unusually polite today.
Dragon's gold? You don't believe that tosh do ye?
I heard old Bilbo met a dragon.
I heard he is a dragon.
Mam says if you're naughty Gandalf'll turn you into a frog!
I don't get why grown ups like that stinky pipeweed anyway.
I'll head back up to Bag End. I've got lots of questions for Gandalf!
So, you mean to go through with your plan then?
Yes, yes. It's all in hand. All the arrangements are made.
Of course he does. He's a Baggins, not some block-headed Bracegirdle from Hardbottle.
Gandalf: Frodo Baggins! Has your uncle not taught you to not listen in on private conversations?
Frodo: I was just coming up to see you two!
Bilbo: Frodo, quick! It's Lobelia. Hide, my boy! Hide!
Lobelia: Bilbo! There you are! Rarely have I been so slighted! Leaving Otho and my good self out of your will!?
Lobelia: You will live to regret this. Oh, you will!
Bilbo's disappointment is immesurable and his day is ruined.
Saruman: Together we shall put an end to this evil!

strings.en: Galadriel: Yet you all are welcome here.

Frodo: If only Gandalf were here with us...
Aragorn: Keep your swords close, my friends. We will find you when this is over.
Celeborn: You bring great evil with you, Frodo Baggins.
Celeborn: Seldom has such an orc-host dared to pass into our realm.
Galadriel: Still, we offer you sanctuary. We will have council later. First, let us repel this vile assault.
Galadriel: Stay close to us, Periannath. Our warriors will see to your safety
They will overwhelm Lord Golasgil! Rally to his aid!
Faramir, do not throw away your life so rashly!
Peregrin Took! This is no place for a hobbit! Fall back to safety.
Sauron underestimates the valour of Gondor. We will make them fight for every stone! Hold! Hold! Or soon our dead will lie upon each of the Seven Levels of Minas Tirith. We must fight! For Gondor!
The gate has fallen! Draw your swords, we must stop them here!
Kill that troll before he destroys the inner gate!
Stop that ram! Before it reaches the inner gate!

We can no longer hold them here. Fall back men!

Gandalf: You cannot enter here. Go back to the abyss prepared for you! Go back!
Fall into the nothingness that awaits you and your Master. Go!
I am a servant of the Secret Fire!
Your fell sorcery will not avail you!
You and your Black Master shall be cast into the Void!
You will not take this City!
The Light of Anar will cast you down!
Gandalf: Victory is slipping from your grasp even as you stretch out your hand to seize it!
Gandalf: Go back to the citadel!
Gandalf: This is no place for a hobbit.
Witch-king: Do not come between the Nazgul and his prey
Witch-king: Do you not know death when you see it, old man?
Witch-king: The world of men will fall.
All this land belongs to the Dark Lord
This is the hour of your doom!

Witch-king: My arm is long, and you are but an aged conjurer.
I have many weapons at my disposal.
Pippin: Denethor has lost his mind!

Soldier: Look! The forces of the Outlands are arriving!
Gandalf: Black clouds gather over the Mountains of Shadow. It will not be long ere the darkness of Mordor reaches the White City.

Gandalf: But Minas Tirith does not stand alone. In its hour of need,
the brave Lords of Gondor's fiefdoms have marshalled what Men they could.
Gandalf: But will it be enough?
Gandalf: Before these walls, upon the fields of the Pelennor, is where the doom of our time shall be decided.
The Lords of Gondor's outlands have rallied to our defence. Follow me, Peregrin Took. Let us welcome these fine Captains of Men.
Brave Lord Forlong! Your doughty axemen will be of great use to the City.
Dervorin, the heir of the Ringlo Vale. I knew your father in his younger years. I am glad to see his strength is carried on in his scion.
Duinhir of Morthond. Your archers are grim-faced and battle-hardened. Gondor thanks you for your swift arrival. These are your sons, I presume?
You have grown into a fine knight, Lord Hirluin. I have heard tell of the gallantry and skill at arms of your warriors.
Long have you defended your realm against the Enemy, Lord Golasgil. I am glad that despite your hardships you have found Men to march to our defence.
Hail Imrahil, son of Adrahil, Prince of Dol Amroth. There are few Men left in Gondor to match your wisdom. Your leadership will prove invaluable in the dark days ahead.
I did not look to find you here, Mithrandir, but I am glad of it!
The Ringlo Vale is devoted to Gondor's defence. We will not let our Steward down.
Aye, Mithrandir. Duilin and Derufin are eager to prove their worth against our Enemy.
Mithrandir! I was but a boy when last I saw you in my father's hall. Worry not, my Men shall throw the Enemy back over their black gates!
It gladdens my heart to meet you here, Mithrandir. Perhaps the fate of Gondor is not as grim as I perceived. Together, we will do all we can to avert its ruin.
The lords of Anfalas remember their oaths well. I have brought what brave Men could be found.
Move onto the walls and ready yourselves! We must prepare to defend the City.

Send these archers to the gate. The Enemy will send forth terrible siege machines. We must do all we can to repel them.
The board is set, the pieces are moving. Minas Tirith is the anvil upon which we smite the armies of Sauron. With luck, we will hold them until help arrives.
Prepare the city, move all forces onto the walls.

Fell Olog-hai! Beregond rally your archers to the gate!

Wicked Men from the East! This will be their end!
Steady! We will hold them here, until the women and children are safe!
A furnace-troll! It will set the city aflame! It must be destroyed!
We have done all we can here! This fight is done! Retreat to the second level!
We cannot tarry! We must reach the second level with all haste!
We must save them, before they're cut down!
Your courage will not be forgotten, friend. May the Valar protect you.

Go on. I will stay behind, to save all those that I can.
