Thorin once gave a shirt of mithril mail to Bilbo...
strings.ru: Торин однажды подарил Бильбо кольчугу из мифрила...

strings.en: Indeed. I never told him, but its worth is greater than half the Shire...
strings.ru: В самом деле. Я никогда не говорил ему, но ее ценность больше, чем половина Шира...

strings.en: The throne of Durin! This is a hallowed place.
So did you know him, this Durin?
It has been a very long time since Durin walked among us.
strings.ru: Я не встречал Дурина при его жизни.

strings.en: The Dwarves of Durin's House believe Durin will be reincarnated seven times.
strings.ru: Гномы Дома Дурина верят, что Дурин будет перевоплощен семь раз.

strings.en: Oh, I see. So what's the current tally?
I will forgive your insolence, master Peregrin, because I know that you cannot help it.
strings.ru: Я прощаю тебе твою наглость, господин Перегрин, потому что знаю, ты никогда не исправишься.

strings.en: The Dwarves of Khazad-dum were dilligent scribes, recording a great many things in close detail.
strings.ru: Гномы Кхазад-дума были прилежными писцами, подробно описавшими множество вещей.

strings.en: We Dwarves take great pride and joy in documenting our lineage through far-branching family trees and tales of the deeds of our fathers.
strings.ru: Мы, гномы, испытываем большую гордость и радость, изучая нашу родословную через далекие, ветвящиеся семейные древа и рассказы о делах наших отцов.

strings.en: Your kin is not so different from ours.
strings.ru: Ваш род не так сильно отличается от нашего.

strings.en: Indeed! We could not read these tomes even if we had time... the language of the Dwarves is a well-kept secret.
strings.ru: В самом деле! Мы не смогли бы прочитать эти тома, даже если бы у нас было бы время... язык гномов - это хорошо сохранившийся секрет.

strings.en: I did not look to find these blades in Moria. They are of Noldorin make!
strings.ru: Я и не думал найти клинки в Мории. Смотрите - они выкованы мастерами нолдорин!

strings.en: In another age, when Khazad-dum flourished, its inhabitants maintained close friendship with the Elves of Eregion.
strings.ru: В другой эпохе, когда Кхазад-дум процветал, его жители поддерживали тесную дружбу с эльфами Эрегиона.

strings.en: It was Celebrimbor himself who drew the signs on the Doors of Durin. The Elves had free passage into Khazad-dum for many years.
strings.ru: Именно Келебримбор нарисовал надписи на Вратах Дурина.

strings.en: Without that drum, many of these vile Goblins will be blind to our passage.
strings.ru: Без этого барабана многие из этих мерзких гоблинов не услышат нас.

strings.en: This map records that the western and southern passages through Moria were overrun by Goblins.
strings.ru: Эта карта показывает, что западные и южные проходы через Морию были захвачены гоблинами.

strings.en: We should take the eastern road when we can.
strings.ru: Мы должны идти по восточной дороге.

strings.en: By my beard! This is the axe of Durin.
So it is, Gimli. Keep it to hand! We may have need of it ere we reach the Mirrormere...
strings.ru: Так оно и есть, Гимли. Держи его под рукой! Он нам понадобится до тех пор, пока мы не достигнем Зеркального озера...

strings.en: Gimli has retrieved Durin's Axe. He will now deal increased damage
strings.ru: Гимли нашел топор Балина. Теперь он будет наносить увеличенный урон

strings.en: Muzgash! That brute has finally fallen.
Gandalf: These papers record the fate of Balin's expedition to reclaim this place...
strings.ru: Гэндальф: В этих бумагах записана судьба отряда Балина, который пытался вернуть это место...

strings.en: Rally together, my kinsmen! We must hold them here, until Oin secures the West-gate!
strings.ru: Сплотимся, друзья мои! Мы должны сдержать их, пока Оин не зачистит западные ворота!

strings.en: Quick! Clear out these wretched Orcs!
Balin! The West-gate is overrun! Disaster is upon us! An army of Orcs approach from the East!
strings.ru: Балин! Западные ворота захвачены! Более того, армия орков приближается с востока!

strings.en: Balin: We cannot win here. We must retreat to the Second Hall and recover our strength.
strings.ru: Нам не удержаться здесь. Мы должны отступить во Второй чертог и восстановить силы.

strings.en: Lend us a hand, would you? We're surrounded!
Durin's Beard! My dear Ori! You yet live!
strings.ru: Борода Дурина! Мой дорогой Оин! Ты еще жив!

strings.en: Lord Balin! Come, we must defend this hall, and secure the passage south!
strings.ru: Господин Балин! Мы должны защитить этот чертог и обеспечить проход на юг!

strings.en: Oin: The Orcs have gathered a great force, and our scouts report terrible sounds coming from the Deeps.
strings.ru: Оин: Орки собрали огромную силу, и наши разведчики сообщают об ужасных звуках, исходящих из глубин.

strings.en: We must reach the Second Hall, with all haste!
strings.ru: Балин: Мы должны дойти до Второго чертога!

strings.en: That is where the account ends..
We must not linger here... I should like to find the Hall of Records.
strings.ru: Мы не должны задерживаться здесь... Я хотел бы найти летописный чертог.

strings.en: Do you mean the Chamber of Mazarbul?
Lord Balin! The Orcs have taken this passage! We will try to hold them off while you find another way!
strings.ru: Господин Балин! Орки взяли этот проход! Мы постараемся удержать их, пока вы не найдете другой путь!

strings.en: With me! We must clear the upper floors quickly!
strings.ru: Ко мне! Мы должны быстро очистить верхние этажи!

strings.en: Look out! They have broken through the eastern entrance!
We must find a way through, away from here!
Lord Balin, retreat along the east road. We will hold them off!
strings.ru: Господин Балин отступает по восточной дороге. Мы будем сдерживать их!

strings.en: Lord Balin! Leave us to it, and retreat to safety!
strings.ru: Господин Балин! Предоставьте это нам и отступайте в безопасное место!

strings.en: Quick, move along! We will cover your retreat!
strings.ru: Быстро, двигайтесь вперед! Мы прикроем ваше отступление!

strings.en: Lord Balin, help us clear this passage.
strings.ru: Господин Балин, помогите нам зачистить этот проход.

strings.en: These are not holes. Of old, Khazad-dum was full of light and splendour, as is still remembered in our songs.
The world was young, the mountains green, No stain yet on the Moon was seen, No words were laid on stream or stone. When Durin woke and walked alone.

He named the nameless hills and dells; He drank from yet untasted wells; He stooped and looked in Mirrormere, And saw a crown of stars appear, As gems upon a silver thread, Above the shadow of his head.

The world was fair, the mountains tall, In Elder Days before the fall, Of mighty kings in Nargothrond And Gondolin, who now beyond The Western Seas have passed away: The world was fair in Durin's Day.
A king he was on carven throne, In many-pillared halls of stone, With golden roof and silver floor, And runes of power upon the door.
The light of sun and star and moon, In shining lamps of crystal hewn, Undimmed by cloud or shade of night, There shone for ever fair and bright.
There hammer on the anvil smote, There chisel clove, and graver wrote; There forged was blade, and bound was hilt; The delver mined, the mason built.
There beryl, pearl, and opal pale, And metal wrought like fishes' mail, Buckler and corslet, axe and sword. And shining spears were laid in hoard.
Unwearied then were Durin's folk; Beneath the mountains music woke: The harpers harped, the minstrels sang, And at the gates the trumpets rang.
The world is grey, the mountains old, The forge's fire is ashen-cold; No harp is wrung, no hammer falls: The darkness dwells in Durin's halls.
The shadow lies upon his tomb In Moria, in Khazad-dum.
But still the sunken stars appear In dark and windless Mirrormere; There lies his crown in water deep, Till Durin wakes again from sleep.
Return to the hall to hear the remainder of the Song of Durin.
There must have been a mighty crowd of Dwarves here at one time. Surely they didn't live in these darksome holes?
We must clear a path through these orcs!
Come on lads, we must keep moving!
The path is clear, come on!
These vile orcs will pay for desecrating our halls!
It's lucky that the tomb wasn't crushed by this massive rock when it fell.
By my beard! This place... untouched by Orcish filth... could it be? Is this Durin's Rest?
That axe... that must be Durin's. By Mahal, I will carry it out of here and keep it safe, so that one day it may be returned to its rightful wielder.
Luck? No. I'll bet half my beard that it was Balin's folk that sealed off all entryways into Durin's Rest.
It appears so, my dear Dwarf. A hallowed place, of great import.
Its edge is said to never dull. Keep it to hand, Gimli. We may have need of it ere we reach the Mirrormere.
There is much you may yet learn from the loremasters of Khazad-dum.
Madril: Faramir, the orcs are pouring through the city. We must reach the western shore before we are overwhelmed.
strings.ru: Мадриль: Фарамир, орки пробиваются через город. Мы должны попасть на западный берег, пока нас не перебили.

strings.en: Madril: There is fierce fighting along the northern border, however the way south remains open to us, for now.
strings.ru: Мадриль: На северной границе идут ожесточенные бои, однако путь на юг пока остается для нас открытым.

strings.en: I do not have the men to protect you from the Nazgul. Frodo, you must take cover in the buildings and make your way back to Meneldil's Square.
strings.ru: У меня нет людей, чтобы защитить вас от назгул. Фродо, вам нужно прятаться в постройках и двигаться обратно к площади Менельдила.

strings.en: We will fight our way back through the streets to draw away Mordor's forces.
strings.ru: Мы будем пробиваться через улицы, чтобы отвлечь силы Мордора.

strings.en: Men, we must defeat the last of these orcs and then make our way back to Meneldil's Square.
strings.ru: Братья, мы должны разбить всех орков до единого, а затем вернуться на площадь Менельдила.

strings.en: Delay could risk the ring of power falling back into the hands of the enemy.
strings.ru: Промедление может привести к тому, что кольцо власти снова попадет в руки врага.

strings.en: Captain Faramir and his men are surrounded! We cannot stay here.
We must seek refuge in the Court of Isildur. Come quickly.
We must keep moving. The Nazgul is still circling above and these ruins offer little cover.
Take the Halflings to safety. We will meet with you once we have repelled this assault.
strings.ru: Отведите полуросликов в безопасное место. Мы встретимся с вами, как только отразим нападение.

strings.en: There is a bridge to the south which will provide us with a shortcut.
strings.ru: На юге есть мост, который обеспечит нам короткий путь.

strings.en: Quickly men! Let us put an end to these orcs and find our way back to the Court of Isildur.
strings.ru: Поторопитесь, люди Гондора! Давайте покончим с этими орками и найдем дорогу обратно ко двору Исильдура.

strings.en: The bridge to the south has been destroyed. We will have to cross through the lower streets.
strings.ru: Мост на юге был разрушен. Нам придется переходить через нижние улицы.

strings.en: We cannot escort the Halflings while that beast patrols above.
strings.ru: Мы не можем сопровождать полуросликов, пока это чудовище патрулирует наверху. Лучники, приготовьте луки!

strings.en: The Fellbeast has been killed, but the Nazgul has not been defeated. Mordor's forces will not scatter while their commander survives.
strings.ru: Падший зверь убит, но назгул не побежден. Силы Мордора не рассеются, пока их командир жив.

strings.en: Faramir: I can take you to the sewers on the outskirts of the city.
strings.ru: Фарамир: Я могу отвести вас в канализацию на окраине города.

strings.en: Faramir: They remain unknown to the enemy and should offer you safe passage past Mordor's rearguard.
strings.ru: Фарамир: Враг не знает о них, так мы сможем безопасно миновать арьергард Мордора.

strings.en:
Faramir: The sacking of the city damaged the flood gates and caused numerous tunnel 
 collapses, so we may have to search for a navigable route.
strings.ru:
Фарамир: Во время разграбления города были повреждены шлюзные врата, что привело к многочисленным обвалам туннелей,
поэтому нам, возможно, придется искать новый маршрут.

strings.en: Faramir: Orc hordes prowl the outer ruins. We cannot risk being caught as this may draw in a larger force.
strings.ru: Фарамир: Орды орков рыщут по внешним руинам. Нам не стоит попадаться им на глаза, так как это может привлечь более крупные силы.

strings.en: Faramir: We must go with extreme caution. We will not have the strength to fight our way through alone.
strings.ru: Фарамир: Мы должны идти с крайней осторожностью. У нас не хватит сил пробиться самостоятельно.

strings.en: There is an entrance to the sewer just ahead.
strings.ru: Вход в канализацию находится прямо перед нами. Идемте скорее!

strings.en: The chaos above has forced the floodgates closed. We will need to open them in sequence to create a route through.
strings.ru: Из-за хаоса наверху шлюзы закрыты. Нам придется последовательно открывать их, чтобы пройти дальше.

strings.en: We will need to split up to open all the gates.
strings.ru: Нам нужно разделиться, чтобы открыть все шлюзы.

strings.en: That did it! Come my friends, the route lies open to us.
strings.ru: Отлично! Путь через канализацию открыт. Вперед, нам пора выбираться наружу.

strings.en: A hero must be close to a gate winch to gain control over the floodgates.
strings.ru: Чтобы получить контроль над шлюзами, герой должен находиться рядом с лебедкой.

strings.en: Don't worry Mr Frodo! We'll get you out of there!
Don't worry! We'll get you out of there.

strings.en: Gimli: What is this place? This rock? I have never seen its like.
Aragorn: It was at this Oathstone that the Men of the Mountain swore their false fealty, and sealed their fate.
Legolas: They have followed us here.
Aragorn: Oathbreakers, why have you come?
King of the Dead: To fulfil our oath and have peace.
Aragorn: The hour of doom is now upon us. I will go to Pelargir upon Anduin, and you shall come after me.
Aragorn: And when this land is clean of the servants of Sauron, I will hold the oath fulfilled, and you shall have peace and depart.
Aragorn: For I am Elessar, the Heir of Isildur of Gondor.
Elladan: The wind carries the sounds of battle!
Aragorn: Let us hasten to their aid!
Pelargir Officer: You have my thanks. But who are you? Why have you come upon Pelargir in its hour of ruin?
Aragorn: I am Aragorn, son of Arathorn. My companions and I have come to liberate the lands of Gondor.
Pelargir Officer: My lord... Pelargir burns. The Southrons have come in numbers as yet unseen in our lifetimes.

Pelargir Officer: They are inside the walls, and guard all passages into the City, by land or by water.
 I fear that soon there will be naught left but smouldering stone.

Pelargir Officer: We have received word that Angbor of Lamedon is coming, but time is against us
 - and we have no means of entering the City.
Aragorn: And yet we must. That Gate needs to be opened from within.
Gimli: It is a dangerous task...
Aragorn: Do not worry, Gimli. I can avoid being seen if I wish.

Pelargir Officer: We might hasten Angbor's arrival by reclaiming the island of Barad Ciryn.
 The beacon can be seen from afar, and does not burn by day unless catastrophe is upon the City.
Aragorn: Then I will reclaim it. But first, I need a boat.
Pelargir Officer: There is an old dock not far from here. But the southrons covet this landing, and will fight to keep it.
Pelargir Officer: We will need our full strength to reclaim the beach. Let us establish a camp and bolster our forces.
This place has been overrun by Corsairs!
Sauron has darkened their very hearts!
These Haradrim are fierce warriors. We must be careful.
We will wait for you, until you open the gates.
This looks like it was hidden here recently... must've been looted by these raiders.
Use the captured fishing boat to transport Aragorn to Barad Ciryn.
Hark! Who are you, and where'd you come from?
Oh, aye? I think not. Get him!
Get over here! We’re getting clobbered!
Who contests our right of conquest!?
You should not have entered Gondor!
It is done. This should hasten Angbor's forces. Now I must reach the city and make for the gate before we are discovered.
These tokens are symbols of Umbarian authority. It could come in useful...
That looks like the safest place to enter the City...
Dying Guard: They are everywhere... Pelargir has fallen.
Aragorn: Not yet. Help will come.
Dying Guard: They are guarding the gate. None can make it out or in.
Dying Guard: They're stockpiling their infernal firepots. Who knows what they're planning...

Dying Guard: It matters little. Cloaked in black... he appeared from
the shadows... and shot me with a poisoned bolt.
Dying Guard: You... who are you?
Dying Guard: Thank you... my lord.

Aragorn: That should slow the poison and stem the bleeding.
Stay out of sight until this is over.
Aragorn: Black cloaks... poisoned darts. The Hasharin have come.

Aragorn: They are a dangerous foe... and the streets are teeming with guards.
I should stay out of sight, lest I bring the whole garrison down upon my head.
Killing too many guards will alert Hasharin assassins. They must be defeated for Aragorn to remain undetected.
Hasharin will always detect Aragorn, even when he is stealthed, if he enters their vision.
While undetected, Aragorn can use these areas to avoid guards.
I have been discovered! I cannot hide from this assassin... I must fight!
I cannot get close. I must find a way to distract them.
If I could set off this cache of firepots, it should draw their attention.
It is alight. I must get to safety!
That will bring them running. Perhaps I can reach the gate now.
The Water Gate. Opening this will free up passage from the River.
Did you see that huge stack of firepots? Wonder what the bosun's planning...
I reckon they're going to blow up the lighthouse. That's gonna be quite a blast...
Oh aye, it'll be heard for miles around!
Aragorn: I can use these alleyways to slip past the guards.

Angbor: The heir of Isildur emerges unscathed from amongst the wreckage
 of the Enemy. We live in strange times indeed.
Aragorn: Hail, Lord Angbor. Your arrival is most timely.
Gimli: Well done, lad! Now, allow us to do our part.
Legolas: This city of Men will be free once more.
My lord, the corsairs are using our guard towers to reinforce their army! We must reclaim them!
They've raised scaffolds around the tower! Strike them down!
The outer district is secure. We must push onto the citadel!
Look ahead - they've blocked our passage. We'll have to smash through it!
We have been deceived! Defend the port!
We must save all that we can!
Thorongil comes! He pursues a vain ambition. The deep one will come for all.
Come forth from the darkest depths!
We are not strong enough yet... back! Across the bridge!
Let us be rid of these Southron invaders!
Clear them out! Throw them back into the sea!
Give them no quarter! No reprieve!
Show them the wrath of Lamedon!
Their fell horn rouses them again! We must destroy it!
The dread horn is sounded! Beware! They will fight with strength renewed!
Reinforcements have landed in the north.
All guard towers in Pelargir must be reclaimed.
Burodapan possesses the Horn of Karna. When it sounds, the Corsairs under his command grow far more dangerous.
The Horn of Karna drives the Corsairs to madness. They will deal more damage while under its influence
Horn of Karna is sounded in:
Pelargir Officer: We've driven them back, but the fight is not yet over.
Pelargir Officer: It seems they intend to withstand us from the Citadel.
Pelargir Officer: They're defending the island by blockade. We must attempt to break through, and land where the wall has been breached!
Pelargir Officer: There is an abandoned black ship nearby. Let us board this vessel and take the fight to them!
Aragorn: Your time is at hand, Men of the Mountain! Come forth and lend us your aid!
King of the Dead: Stand, ye wrathful dead! Fight now, and earn the rest you crave!
The landing is clear, but the island is heavily guarded.
Pah, nothing we haven't faced before.
Come, my friends! It is time to reclaim Tol Rammath!
Burodapan: You old fool! We should have left when we had the chance! Now he is upon us!
Cassimir: Be off then, you plundering coward! I will avenge our father.
Cassimir: Thorongil's head will be on a spike outside of my palace, and all shall know the supremacy of the line of Herumor!
Burodapan: I will not die for your lordship, brother. This war is a fool's errand. I serve a greater purpose.
The Enemy sends forth more of their ships. I will send the Dead to bar their passage.
Cassimir: Thorongil! Today, I will do what my father could not. Your false line ends here!
Aragorn: Surrender, lord, and I will grant you clemency.
Cassimir: I will not bow. Draw your sword!
The Blood of the West courses through my veins!
I will not fall... I will not!
The high blood of Umbar is not yet spent!
Fall like the dog you really are!
Once you have fallen, your city will be next!
King of the Dead: Release us!
King of the Dead: You gave us your word!
Gimli: They have fought mightily. Their debt is surely paid.
Aragorn: I hold your oath fulfilled... Go... be at peace.
let nothing stand in our way!
Flee or be slain where you stand!
If we do not act quickly, all the free peoples shall share the grim fate of this city!
This is Aragorn, son of Arathorn. He is the heir of Elendil, and to the Throne of Gondor.
I will lend you my aid, kinsmen.
We've done it. The tower is ours!
Their banners have been struck! This tower belongs to us.
Only one tower remains to them, let us claim it!
The forces of Umbar overrun this area. We should find another way.
Look, they have captured more soldiers!
Gather arms, Men! Help us reclaim your city!
They have set the streets ablaze! We must rescue all that we can!
We will push you back into the sea!
You and your lords will pay for your incursions!
You will fear the sons of Arnor!
Stand your ground, more are coming!
Imrahil and Eomer will be overwhelmed in:
Destroy all catapults and trolls to drive the Enemy from the Pelennor
Use your Rohirrim's Song of Battle to regain health.
Dismount your Rohirrim to help counter the Mumakil
Collect shields from the battlefield to withstand the Witch-king's attacks.
Theoden: Ride now! Ride now! Ride! Ride for ruin and the world's ending!
Drive forward, let us end the siege!
Watch out! Keep out of its range!
Steel answers steel - forward men of Dunland!
They will sing of your wrath, Theoden Thengels-son!
Eomer: Press onward! Take them down!
Eomer: Drive them to the River!
Theoden: Reform the lines! Reform the lines!
Theoden: Gamling! Guard our rear, back towards the city! Grimbold! Take your company and secure the flank!
Theoden: Quickly! Reclaim the village and take defensive positions!
Sound the charge! Meet them head on!
Ride, my warriors! The Black Serpent is with you!
Kill their king! End this now!
You cannot withstand the fury of Sûladan!
Quickly! Use the build plots to fortify our position!
Have you ever seen the like of 'em?
What new foe is this? They're no orc!
The Southrons bear down on us once more!
Their Lord approaches! Slay him! Break their will!
We knew you had not forsaken us!
Imrahil: Amroth! Amroth! Amroth for Gondor!
Theoden: Rally to me! To me!
Eowyn: I will kill you if you touch him!
Witch-king: Do not come between the Nazgul and his prey
Witch-king: You fool, no man can kill me! Die now!
Merry: Lady I won't leave you!
Begone, foul Dwimmerlaik! Lord of Carrion! Leave the dead in peace!
Imrahil: Gondor endures! Hold the line, my lords, though the night closes in around us.
Eomer: Stand fast! Let all remember that Rohan did not yield while breath remained!
Boromir: We must hold the line!
Forlong: Fight on, sons of Gondor!
Out of doubt, our of dark, to the day's rising, to hope's end I rode and to heart's breaking!
Dunhere fought to the last, he will be avenged!
Men of Gondor! Of Rohan! Here we make our stand!
Dol Amroth will not falter this day!
Guritz: Late as usual, pirate scum! There's knifework here needs doing!
Guritz: Come on, you sea-rats! Get off your ships!
Gimli: There's plenty for the both of us! May the best Dwarf win!
Aragorn: Unfurl the banner of Elendil! Forward, Men of Gondor!
Aragorn: Legolas, what of the White City? Are we too late?
Legolas: There is great ruin of fire across the field. The Enemy is everywhere and there is heavy fighting in front of the City.
Aragorn: Then that is where we will go.
Halbarad: We cannot delay! The Prince of Dol Amroth is greatly outnumbered!
Legolas: We must find a way across here quickly.
You are not forsaken, rally to me!

Imrahil: Who are you, that has come to our aid so fortuitously? We did not look to 
 see any allies come into Harlond this day, let alone beneath black sails.
Aragorn: That will do, Halbarad. I will make no claims before Sauron is defeated.
Boromir: Here is a valiant captain of Men. It is good to see you, Aragorn.
Eomer: You come none too soon, my friend. Much loss and sorrow has befallen us.
Aragorn: Then let us avenge it ere we speak of it!
Imrahil: So it will be, my Lord Aragorn. We will take the fight to the Enemy!
Imrahil: Their host gathers in the south. We must strike at their camp before they regain their strength.
Gimli: Let us be rid of them!
Halbarad: Come, servants of Shadow! Face the doom your Master has made for you!
Gothmog: You think the might of Mordor is spent? Fool! You herald your own doom!
Halbarad! You do not stand alone!
Scum! My guards will deal with you!
Boromir: Drive them out, let none return!
Soldier: The ENEMY is retreating! Victory is ours!
Elfhelm: The ENEMY is retreating! Victory is ours!
Faramir: For the glory of Gondor!
Aragorn: They are broken, drive them from the field!
Aragorn: Halbarad, my truest friend. For you to fall when the aim for which you fought was so near is a grievous hurt.
Aragorn: Be at peace, son of Arnor.

Faramir: The Heir of Elendil has come forth, father. To refuse him would bring dishonour upon our House.
It is by the leadership of Aragorn that the Enemy has been repelled.
Denethor: What say you of this, Boromir?
Denethor: Leave me. I require time and silence to examine the meaning of these events.
Denethor: The time of my thought is yet mine to spend, Faramir!

Boromir: This is a time to rejoice, father. Turning Aragorn away would invite chaos amongst our ranks.
This war is not over, and we must press our advantage whilst we can.
Denethor: It is due to Boromir's counsel that I have come to realise what must be done.

Denethor: Today, I must render unto thee not merely lordship of my lands, but also of my people,
whose lives and well-being are near to my heart.
Aragorn: Hail, Lord Denethor, Steward of Gondor. A star shines upon the hour of our meeting.

Aragorn: The House of Stewards has long seen to the survival of Gondor. Though I will take up kingship over you,
I wish for you to remain at your post, and defend Minas Tirith in my absence.
Aragorn: Only together do we have a chance at victory.

Gondor Soldier: Lord Eomer of Rohan! Your sister has been taken to the Houses of Healing. She yet lives,
but is near death! You must go to her at once!

Aragorn: This City and realm has rested in the charge of the Stewards for many long years,
and I will not make any claim until it is seen whether we or Mordor shall prevail.

Aragorn: No. But I deem the time unripe, and I have no mind for strife except with our Enemy and his servants.
I will await the welcome of the Lord of the City.

Eomer: You have raised the king's banner and displayed the tokens of Elendil's House.
Will you suffer these to be challenged?
Imrahil: Your words are wise, lord. But I would not have you remain like a beggar at the door.
Gandalf: Denethor is no more. His son, now Steward, lies gravely wounded at the Houses of Healing.
Gandalf: Eomer, your sister is there also. She yet lives, but is near death. Go to her!

Gandalf: The hands of the king are the hands of a healer, and so shall the rightful king be known.
Come, Aragorn. You are needed.
Boromir: Nor the courage of Gondor.

Aragorn: We have come now to the very brink. To waver is to fall. We must march upon the Black Gate,
to draw out Sauron's armies and give Frodo what time we can.
Eomer: I know little of these deep matters. But you came to our rescue, and if you go, I will follow.
Imrahil: Then you would have us retreat to our castles and await our doom?
Imrahil: Nor the courage of Gondor.

Gandalf: At great cost have we survived the first assault. The next will be greater.
Prudence would counsel you to strengthen what strong places remain to you.
Gandalf: No, for I do not counsel prudence. I believe that we must place our hope in the destruction of the Ring of Power.
Legolas: We have come this far, Aragorn. We are with you.
Gimli: Aye. Let none doubt the steadfastness of Durin's Folk.
Legolas: Your kinsmen may have no need to ride to war; I fear war already marches on their own lands.
Gimli: I wish I could summon some of our own kinsfolk south. A contingent of stout Dwarves, eager for battle.
Be on your guard, there will be more wolves hunting on these hills tonight.
Celebrimbor: This place... it must be forgotten...
I feel the pull of the One! I hear his voice! Be gone!
Death! That is all I grant!
Abandon all hope... it has forsaken you!
I forged wonders... and wrought only ruin! Such is the fate of all things!
These are the ruins of Ost-in-Edhil... once an Elven center for trade and craftsmanship...
Then Sauron the Deceiver laid it to waste, and killed its lord: Celebrimbor, the creator of the Rings of Power.
Memory lingers within these stones. Can you hear their slow lamentation?
There is a cave here! We should seek shelter and recover our strength.
These were no ordinary wolves hunting for food in the wilderness. How much further to the Mines?
Caves in the mountains are seldom unoccupied.
Then we should make haste! Balin will grant us shelter and protection from these mangy creatures!
Draw your blades, and stand back to back!
I will shrivel you from tail to snout!
We are close to the walls of Moria.
Anguished memories of a bygone age... do not let them take you!
Still your wrath! Return to your slumber!
Indeed. Let us move north while the light is with us.
We should take this with us.
This looks worth carrying to me.
This place was once great... it is sad to see it destroyed by evil.
Gildor: You are safe here, my friends. Frodo, I know of your burden. Allow us to do our part in lessening its weight.
strings.ru: Гилдор: Здесь вы в безопасности, друзья мои. Фродо, я знаю о твоем бремени. Позволь нам внести свой вклад, чтобы облегчить твою ношу.

strings.en: Merry: A gloom lies upon the land.
Sam: What's happened to the trees? Magnificent old oaks - why have they been cut down?
Old Hob: Oi! Who goes there!
Old Hob: Be off! You can't come in.
Old Hob: Can't you read the notice: No admittance between sundown and sunrise? We have orders.
Old Hob: The Chief's up at Bag End.
Pippin: If you mean that your precious Chief has been hiring ruffians out of the wild, then we've not come back too soon.
Sam: Bill Ferny! Well, there's a face I'd hoped never to see again...
Bill Ferny: Oh, I remember you. I'll bet that old pony keeled over 'fore you lot reached Staddle. He he he.
Sam: Don't you speak ill of him! A nobler friend there never was, and he's doing quite alright, I'll have you know!
Bill Ferny: Don't mistake me for some softhearted dullard that cares, halfling. And don't think I've forgotten about that apple, either. I'll throw something at you, now!
Bill Ferny: Troublemakers is it? Thought you'd sneak back in past curfew?

Bill Ferny: Well now, I remember you lot. The folks what bought my pony off me in Bree!
 I'll bet it keeled over 'fore you lot reached Staddle. He he he.
Bill Ferny: Don't mistake me for some softhearted dullard that cares, halfling.
Bill Ferny: Now be off! Or I'll send you downriver myself!
Merry: Come on, Pippin! Two is enough!
Pippin: More than enough, Merry. These ruffians don't frighten me one bit.
Bill Ferny: You think you've got the upper hand, do you? You'll see! You'll see soon enough!
Old Hob: You lot have changed, haven't you? Hmm. Very well.
Let's stop at nearby Frogmorton, and see what there is to see.
Such a shame what they've done to the trees...
You reckon they'll move on soon?
What do you want? Get out of my sight!
What, you think you're better than me!?
Shirrif: Halt! You're arrested for Gatebreaking, and Tearing up of Rules, and Assaulting Gatekeepers, and Trespassing.
Shirrif: Chief's orders! We're to take you to Bywater and hand you over to his Men.
Sam: You've got some nerve, arresting good Mr. Frodo!
Frodo: It's alright, Sam. We'll come along.
Pippin: Or rather, you'll come along with us!
Shirrif: Don't try to run, now! Stay on the road, if you know what's good for you.
What's happened here? Who are all these Men?
There's been strange folk abound for some time. But their Chief only arrived a month or so ago. Since then, things have changed. Rules, regulations. Lock-holes, overflowing.
You're Will Hayfoot aren't you? I thought I recognised you. I used to see you fishing by Bywater Pool.
Aye... well. Things are different now, Mr. Frodo. That was before the Rules.
What Chief? You mean Bill Ferny?
Huh? No, not Bill. The Chief's some outsider. Came buying land and stores little by little, and before long his big folk were giving orders all across the Shire.
They've torn down the Old Mill, and built a new one. Nasty place. It befouls the air and the water. Sandyman's in charge. He seems to like it.
Sam: That Sandyman always had the makings of a villain.
They've got many of us slaving away in their work pits, shaping stone and baking bricks. It's a sorry affair, indeed.
The Chief's set up at Bag End. He's filled the Party Field with lodgings for his Men. You'll get your say before him. Make it easy, if you want the shortest possible stay in the lock-holes.
Bag End? What a dreadful prospect.
Half-orc: Where d'you think you're going? You little folk are getting too uppish. You'll do what Sharkey says.
Pippin: Mind yourself, now. You're speaking to a friend of the King! You best ask for pardon!
Half-orc: Is that right? We'll see about that.
Sam: I cannot abide this, Mr. Frodo. We've got to do something.
Merry: We will, Sam! We've not come this far to see the Shire brought to ruin!
Innkeep: Mr. Baggins! Is it really you?
Innkeep: We thought you were dead!
Innkeep: Things are in a bad way, Mr. Frodo. Worse than you can imagine.

Innkeep: They tore down Sandyman's old mill and raised a great ugly thing of brick and iron. 
 Nasty place. Smoke pours from it day and night, and it's fouled the air and water for miles.

Innkeep: Ted Sandyman's the master of the New Mill now. 
 Him and his cronies have had the run of things, ever since the big folk took over.
Innkeep: They've got many of us slaving away in their camps, felling trees and hauling stone. It's a sorry affair, indeed.
We better deal with those camps before we head to the Mill. We don't want any nasty surprises creeping up behind us.
Innkeep: Mr. Baggins. Is it really you?
Innkeep: We thought you were dead!
Frodo: What's going on here? What's got hold of everyone?
Sam: That Ted always had a mean streak in him.
Come! Let us rid ourselves of that foul mill.
Innkeep: The big folk have been confiscating fireworks. They've got it all stashed nearby.
Pippin: Fireworks? Good. They'll come in useful.
Hobbit: We'll take back the Shire!
Hobbits still live in Holes that have white smoking chimneys. Use Merry's 'Rohirric Horn' ability near hobbit holes to summon allies!
There's lots of them hanging about. We need to gather as many hobbits as we can!
They gather around their camps! We've got to put them out of commission!
If we take care of these camps, more hobbits will come out to help!
We've destroyed one of their camps!
Look! It's another one of their camps!
Their camps are gone. That'll thin out their patrols.
Young Masters Meriadoc and Peregrin have returned!
Hobbit: That's our sign! We're rising up!
Greetings, masters! We've gathered what brave hobbits we could. Now, let's remove these ruffians from our lands!
I think we've roused them all.
Watch out! They're guarding the bridge!
Sod this! We need more men! I'll go find some!
You're the expert, Pippin. You set up the fireworks. Just make sure you stick 'em in the ground.
Move Pippin to the New Mill to start setting up fireworks. Protect him while he is setting them up for the Ruffians will try to stop you.
The Ruffians will be coming back soon!
They are trying to destroy the mill!
Chief'll have us if we let them destroy the mill!
Pippin: The fireworks are set! Ruuuuuuuun!
There, that will show those ruffians! Let's hope they never return.
Their Chief is holed up at Bag End. Let us waste no time and go to the Party Field.
Show 'em what we do to rebels!
Capture 'em, or kill 'em if you like - Boss won't care!
Sam: No! They've cut it down! They've cut down the Party Tree!

Sam: See here, Master Sandyman, I've a score to pay in this village, 
 and don't you make it any longer with your jeering, or you'll foot a bill too big for your purse.
Sam: Is that why you betrayed your kind? Your home?!
Merry: Your Sharkey seems to have taken quite a liking to you, Sandyman.
Pippin: I reckon that's not without cause. Now be off, and take your henchmen with you!
Sam: I reckon that's not without cause. Now be off, and take your henchmen with you!
Ted Sandyman: Don't like it, Sam? You were always soft. What d'you want to come back for?
Ted Sandyman: We've work to do in the Shire now. Sharkey's made me nice and rich, and he'll build me another mill - if I turn you lot in!
Ted Sandyman: You can't touch me. I'm a friend of the Boss. But he'll touch you all right, if I have any more of your mouth!
I ain't scared of no gardener!
Come on, help out your employer!
Go back to your fairy stories!
Ted Sandyman: You win! Stay your hand!
Ted Sandyman: You've changed, alright. But you won't stand a chance against the new owner of Bag End.
Ted Sandyman: I had no choice! The way things were going, it was submit or be thrown out, or worse!

Ted Sandyman: You think you've won? This'll come back on you double! They'll have you chained up, just like your Old Gaffer. 
 I bet he's breaking his back in the work camp even now, Sam - if he's still alive to find!
Ruffian Guard: Work, or taste the lash!
Hobbit: We've got to set our friends free!
Hobbits have been put to work in the Work Pit, free them and they'll join the fight for the Shire!
What's this? Bunch of halflings on the loose?!
These rats don't look like they're from 'round here! Let's show 'em the new order of things!
Sam! Is that you, my boy? Come and help your old dad!
So, you're back!? Word of your crimes has traveled! Sharkey says I better handle it, so handle it I will! Come on, boys!
You can't be treating me like this!
No more! No more! I yield!
Ugh! You'll regret this, all of you, hnngh
Gaffer: Samwise! Mr. Baggins! My young friends! I'm so very glad you're back!
Sam: What have they done to you, my dear old Gaffer?
Gaffer: Nothing that won't heal on its own, dear Sam. There's worse things afoot.
Gaffer: I heard them talking about reinforcements. They're sending up more of these ruffians!
Ruffian: They're rising up! Stop them!
Merry: They'll come up Bywater Road. It cuts through an earth-bank. We can waylay them there!
Gaffer: It seems the bridge-guards have abandoned their posts.
My friends! You've returned! All of you, and in one piece!
We'll show these villains what for!
I've got a rock for you!
Move to the Ambush site to prepare your defences.
The Ruffian horde will arrive in
We can set up some fireworks along the ridge! That'll spook them.
This is it! Here they come!
There's more coming! Stand your ground!
Keep their villainy at bay! The Shire is ours!
Look at that! They're getting blasted!
It's just a bunch of halflings! Get 'em!
Frodo: It isn't over yet. Bag End is still not free.
Sam: Then let us go and see about this Chief of theirs.
Sam: This is worse than Mordor! Our homes, all ruined!
Frodo: This is Mordor. Or rather, one of its works.
Frodo: Saruman. You are the Chief? The one they call Sharkey?
Saruman: You've heard the name, have you? A term of endearment, no doubt.
Saruman: Gandalf! Do not speak to me of Gandalf!
Frodo: Why have you done this?

Saruman: Why? You ask that? My home, wrecked! Saruman, turned away like a beggar! 
Did you think yourself safe? You are a fool.

Saruman: I set out to teach you a lesson. 
One ill turn deserves another.
Take m boss, I'll make sure no more come from this direction gnehehe!
Even now, you are no match!
You were mere pawns in Gandalf's game!
Worm will take care of you!
I'll take care of you myself!
Hobbit: Don't let him go! He's a villain and a murderer. Kill him! Kill him!

Sharkey: Yes, kill him, if you think there are enough of you! But do not think that I am powerless! 
 Whoever strikes me shall be accursed. And if my blood stains the Shire, it shall never be healed!
Your words are poison, Saruman. I will have you speak no more, slay him!
I have done much that you will find hard to mend or undo in your lives. And it will be pleasant to think of that and set it against my injuries.
Do not believe him! I will not have him slain. It is useless to meet revenge with revenge.
Go, Saruman, by the speediest way!
To the road again, Worm! These fine fellows and lordlings are turning us adrift again. Come along!
It seems that Gandalf's impudence has taken root in you. All that suffering, and no lesson learned.
I offered you mercy, Saruman, and you repaid it with treachery. One ill turn deserves another - kill him.

Frodo: He was great once, of a noble kind that we should not dare to raise our hands against. 
 I would spare him, in the hope that he may find some cure.
Sharkey: You are wise, and cruel. You have robbed my revenge of sweetness, and now I am in debt to your mercy. I hate it and you!

Sharkey: I will trouble you no more. But do not expect me to wish you health and long life. 
 You will have neither. But that is not my doing. I merely foretell.
Frodo: Grima! You need not follow him!
Sharkey: Follow! Follow, you wretched cur!
Frodo: You can stay here a while, and rest ere you take to the road.
Hobbit: We can't let the villain get away! Get him!
Sharkey: No evil? Oh no! What of poor Lotho? You know, don't you, Worm? Will you tell them?

Sharkey: Worm killed him. Poor fellow. Stabbed him in his sleep, I believe. Buried him, I hope; 
 though Worm has been very hungry lately. You had better leave him to me.
Sharkey: You do what Sharkey says, always, don't you, Worm? Well, now he says - follow! Follow, you wretched cur!
Sam: This was the very last end of the War, I hope.
Frodo: I hope so too. To think it had to happen here, at the very door of Bag End.
Sam: Now we must clean up the mess. And that'll take a lot of time and work.
Haven't seen your smug faces 'round here before!
Return to the notice board to read more rules.

THE NEW RULES 
 
 As spoken by Sharkey, Lord of the Shire 
 Abbreviated for the Purpose of Signage and thus Non-Exhaustive 
 For a full Charter, set an appointment with The Chief.

Rule Number One 
 
 It is hereby Ordered that no Hobbit shall gather, keep, or consume ale, beer, cider, or other strong drink save by Licence duly granted by the Chief's Men, and only in such quantity as they shall deem fit.

Rule Number Two 
 
  No tree shall be felled, pruned, climbed, or otherwise meddled with except by express Written Permission; provided always that the Chief's Men may cut whatsoever trees they require, without notice or appeal.

Rule Number Three
 
 Every Hobbit between the ages of fifteen and one hundred shall present himself for Labour when called upon, and any refusal, delay, or complaint shall be deemed wilful Idleness and punished accordingly.
... The first few pages appear torn off. Only the last few remain:

Rule Number Seventeen 
 
 No gathering exceeding three persons shall be held in any inn, lane, field, or dwelling after sunset without Leave first obtained from the Shiriffs. Conversation touching upon former customs, absent persons, or matters of governance shall be especially discouraged.

Rule Number Eighteen 
 
 Any speech tending to bring the Chief, his Rules, his Men, or the New Order into Ridicule, Contempt, or Disrepute shall be accounted Mischief of a Serious Nature, whether spoken plainly, hinted broadly, sung, muttered, or overheard.

Rule Number Nineteen 
 
 No weapons of any kind shall be kept or carried by Hobbits without special permission, and any such items found shall be seized.

Rule Number Twenty 
 
 All former customs and traditions shall give way to these Rules, which shall take precedence in all matters, and any uncertainty shall be resolved in favour of the Chief and his authority.

Крайнего Запада... мой дух взывает к исходу. Спасибо тебе, Фродо Бэггинс.

strings.en:

strings.ru:

у тебя хватит сил противостоять ему. Иди, и да пребудет с тобой благословение Белого Оленя.

strings.en: Smeagol: The Black Gate is very close.
Sinda Spirit: You must go no further, periannath. The dead lie in wait.

Sinda Spirit: They perished needlessly under my command. Now, consumed by rage and grief, 
 they are shackled here by the dark power that slew them long ago.

Sinda Spirit: The evil spell that binds us to this wretched land must be broken. 
 Find the barrows of the dead, and destroy them. Only then can you pass.
Sinda Spirit: It is time this torment is ended. Aid me in freeing my kin, and I will see you safely through the marshes.
Sinda Spirit: I know this place... A barrow, to hold the fallen. Sons of Doriath, of Lindon... friends.
It stood dry then.. raised in haste upon the wide plains of Dagorlad, where our great Host made war.
But the world has changed... The waters creep slowly over the centuries, fed by sorrow.
Not I alone. But I laid stones here, weeping.
Sinda Spirit: We could not take them west. So we buried them beneath sky and wind....But evil seeps into forgotten things.
Sinda Spirit: What once held memory now holds malice.
The way forward is drowned. This barrow stands on an isle of firm ground. Follow its path, it leads through the mire.
Yes... But something stirs... a shadow dwells here now.
I cannot hold it. The living must bear it. Restore it, periannath, and this place may yet be stilled.
Sinda Spirit: My friend... what has become of you...
He guards the path. We must defeat him before we can move on.
The wraith has faded. But for how long I cannot say. We must move quickly.
The wraiths return! We must banish them!
I will give you the rest you crave!
Sam: Barrows? The dead!? What do we do?!
Sam: There's a mound, Mr Frodo... just there. Almost looks like a hill, but too even.
Frodo: The dead? Who are you?
Frodo: We seek safe passage. Can you aid us?
Frodo: We have no choice but to trust him.
Frodo: Thank you, friend. May you finally find peace.
Tethered Lord: You should not have come here.
Fools for kings... you will find no rest.
It was you who doomed us!
Tethered King: You do not belong here. None of you. This place is mine.
Come to me, friends of old!
Gollum: No master! They catch you!
My kinsmen often pass through these lands.
Strider: This blade is of Arnor before its fall... my kin must be close by.
strings.ru: Странник: Этот клинок из Арнора еще до его падения... Мои родичи должно быть где-то рядом.
Странник: Дым поднимается... Я должен осмотреться.

strings.en: Strider: My friends... what evil fate has befallen you...
strings.ru: Странник: Братья мои... что за злая судьба настигла вас...

strings.en: You will pay for your cruelty, fell creatures!
This land lies under a dark spell... I must return to the hill!
strings.ru: Эта земля находится под темным чарами ... Я должен вернуться к холму!

strings.en: Sam, do you know what Kingsfoil is?
strings.ru: Сэм, ты знаешь, что такое королевский лист?

strings.en: It will not cure him but we may slow the poison.
strings.ru: Это не исцелит его, но мы можем замедлить яд.
Смотрите! Это те тролли мистера Бильбо!

strings.en:
Glorfindel: Aragorn! The Enemy is near. You cannot outrun them. But the Ford of Bruinen is close! 
 Frodo, let Asfaloth bear you at speed to the crossing. My kin awaits you there.

Glorfindel: Aragorn! The Enemy is near. You cannot outrun them. But the Ford of Bruinen is close! 
 Frodo, let Asfaloth bear you at speed to the crossing. My kin awaits you there.
strings.ru:
Враг рядом. Вы не сможете опередить их. Но брод Бруинена уже близко!
Фродо, позволь Асфалоту перенести тебя до переправы. Моя семья ждет тебя там.

strings.en: Glorfindel: Begone, fell things! Hollow things! Fall into the void that awaits you and your master!
strings.ru: Глорфиндел: Прочь, ничтожные твари! Низвергнитесь в пустоту к своему повелителю!

strings.en: If you want him, come and claim him!
strings.ru: Если он тебе нужен, подойди и возьми!

strings.en: I can see an Athelas bushel up on that ridge!
strings.ru: Я вижу куст Ацеласа на этом хребте!

strings.en: Glorfindel! We must hold them in check while the Hobbits escape!
We cannot hold them here! Fall back to the Fords!
I cannot protect you in these Fords, Hobbits! Retreat to safety!
Glorfindel: We must reach reach the fords with all haste!
Come, we must get the Hobbits across the River!
You will not enter the Hidden Valley, spawn of Sauron!
Warriors of Imladris! We must defeat these creatures!
The forces of Mordor come forth one last time. They must not cross the Bruinen!
The southern gate cannot fall or the town will be overrun.
strings.ru: Южные врата не должны пасть, иначе город будет захвачен.

strings.en: Destroying collapsed beams will free trapped villagers.
strings.ru: Устранение завалов позволит освободить попавших в ловушку жителей.

strings.en: Choose either the Northern or Southern route.
The gatehouse and inner area must be cleared of Isengard forces for the gates to be closed.
strings.ru: Чтобы закрыть врата, необходимо очистить сторожку и внутреннюю территорию от сил Изенгарда.

strings.en: My lords the gate has been barricaded closed and cannot be opened. There is a postern gate to the north that will offer you free passage.
strings.ru: Милорды, врата забаррикадированы и не могут быть открыты. На севере есть скрытый проход, которым вы можете свободно пользоваться.

strings.en: Push the attackers out of the city.
Isengard has broken through the north eastern wall.
The signal fires have been lit. Erkenbrand's forces will arrive soon.
strings.ru: Сигнальные костры зажжены. Эркенбранд скоро прибудет.

strings.en: Isengard will attack the south west gate in:
strings.ru: Изенгард возобновит атаку на юго-западные врата через:

strings.en: Gandalf Greyhame, you are a welcome surprise.
Our defences grow weak and Isengard has overwhelmed our Eastern guard.
strings.ru: Наша оборона слабеет. Изенгард одолел нашу стражу на востоке.

strings.en: Please meet with Dunhere, my captain, in the town centre. He will surely have need of your assistance.
strings.ru: Пожалуйста, встретьтесь с Дунхерэ, моим капитаном, в центре города. Ему наверняка понадобится ваша помощь.

strings.en: Gandalf: Rally your men to the bridge. My companions and I will do what we can to aid you in this fight.
strings.ru: Гэндальф: Собери своих людей на мосту. Я и мои спутники сделаем все возможное, чтобы помочь вам в этой битве.

strings.en: Legolas: Gandalf, I will stay behind to lend my aid to the defenders.
strings.ru: Леголас: Гэндальф, я задержусь, чтобы оказать помощь защитникам

strings.en: Gimli: I will stay with the Elf. There will likely be axe work that needs doing.
strings.ru: Гимли: Я останусь с эльфом. Скорее всего, нужно будет поработать топором

strings.en:
Dunhere: Gandalf Greyhame. This is indeed an unexpected meeting. 
 I am Dunhere, captain of the guard at Upbourn while my Lord Erkenbrand is away.
strings.ru:
Дунхерэ: Гэндальф. Вот так неожиданная встреча!
Я Дунхерэ, командир стражи Апборна, до тех пор пока милорд Эркенбранд в отъезде.

strings.en: Dunhere: Your arrival brings us much needed relief. We are beset on all sides.
strings.ru: Дунхерэ: Ваше прибытие принесло нам столь необходимое облегчение. Нас осаждают со всех сторон!

strings.en: Dunhere: The Eastern gates have been destroyed. Isengard's raiders now flood the city.
strings.ru: Дунхерэ: Восточные врата были разрушены, а мародеры Изенгарда наводнили город.

strings.en: Dunhere: My men and I can hold the bridge, but we are cut off from the Eastern guard.
strings.ru: Дунхерэ: Я и мои люди можем удерживать мост, но мы отрезаны от восточной стражи.

strings.en: Dunhere: There is a flanking route to the north, and one to the south.
strings.ru: Дунхерэ: Есть обходной путь на севере и еще один на юге.

strings.en: Dunhere: An unexpected attack should give us an opportunity to break their lines and free the city.
strings.ru: Дунхерэ: Внезапная атака должна дать нам возможность прорвать их ряды и освободить город.

strings.en:
Dunhere: I owe you my thanks, Gandalf. Were it not for you and your 
 companions, we would not have been able to withstand these raiders.
strings.ru:
Дунхерэ: Я должен поблагодарить тебя, Гэндальф. Если бы не ты и твои
спутники, мы были бы обречены.

strings.en: Dunhere: However, I must once again ask you for your assistance in defending Upbourn.
strings.ru: Дунхерэ: Однако я должен еще раз попросить вас о помощи.

strings.en: Dunhere: My outriders have reported that a larger and more formidable army approaches.
strings.ru: Дунхерэ: Мои всадники доложили, что приближается более многочисленная и грозная армия.

strings.en: Dunhere: The force has broken up, so that they may attack all three entrances to the city.
strings.ru: Дунхерэ: Их войска разделились, чтобы атаковать все три входа в город.

strings.en:
Dunhere: The Northern and Southern Gates still stand for now, 
 but we cannot prevent them from entering the Eastern side of the city.
strings.ru:
Дунхерэ: Северные и Южные врата все еще держатся,
но мы не можем помешать им войти с востока.

strings.en: Dunhere: They have also established a forward base in the south east of the lowland woods.
strings.ru: Дунхерэ: Они также создали передовую базу на юго-востоке леса в низине.

strings.en:
Dunhere: Upbourn is burning... I fear it is lost. But if we defeat this force and 
 destroy their camp, then we may yet have a chance to save the refugees.
strings.ru:
Дунхерэ: Апборн горит... Боюсь, он потерян. Но если мы победим это войско и
уничтожим их лагерь, тогда у нас еще может быть шанс спасти беженцев.

strings.en: My Lord Erkenbrand is returning from the Fords of Isen... I fear the grim news he will bring. But if we light the Signal Fires to the East and West they will hasten to our aid!
strings.ru: Мой лорд Эркенбранд с армией возвращается с Изенских бродов... Я боюсь он несет мрачные вести. Если мы зажжем сигнальные костры на востоке и западе, то они ускорят шаг, чтобы прийти к нам на помощь!

strings.en: The signal fires have been lit! Lord Erkenbrand's forces will see our signal and should arrive soon.
strings.ru: Сигнальные костры зажжены!Лорд Эркенбранд увидит наш сигнал и скоро прибудет!

strings.en: Lord Erkenbrand! I am greatly relieved to see you alive and well. Saruman's hand has reached us here at Upbourn... let us beat him back together!
strings.ru: Лорд Эркенбранд! Я так рад видеть вас живым и здоровым! Длань Сарумана дотянулась и до Апборна... давайте же соберем все силы в кулак и отбросим ее приспешников!

strings.en: Isengard has broken through the North-eastern Wall!
Saruman's forces approach the Southern Gate!
strings.ru: Силы Сарумана приближаются к южным вратам!

strings.en: Isengard is attacking the Northern Gate!
Look out! Armored Trolls from Isengard!
The Gate has fallen! We must not waver, Men of Rohan!
strings.ru: Врата пали! Не страшитесь, люди Рохана!

strings.en: We must defeat their leader before they tear Upbourn apart!
strings.ru: Мы должны обезглавить их войско, иначе Апборн не выстоит!

strings.en: Sharku? Was that his foul name? Pah. He lies dead in the mud.
strings.ru: Шарку? Так звали этого мерзавца? Его труп валяется в грязи.

strings.en: That's it! We've defeated them all!
All that remains is to destroy their fetid camp...
strings.ru: Все, что осталось, это уничтожить их поганый лагерь...

strings.en: Fight on Men of Rohan! Bema is with you!
strings.ru: Сражайтесь, люди Рохана! Бема с вами!

strings.en: Run back to Isengard, fell creature!
strings.ru: Беги обратно в Изенгард, падшая тварь!

strings.en: Defender: My lords, we need to close this gate! Help us push back these filthy Uruk-hai!
That did it! Thank you! Please, make your way to the Eastern side of the city. The garrison there will surely have need of your aid!
We are safe for now, but we must prepare Upbourn before Saruman's forces return. Please, seek out captain Dunhere.
We must make our way back to the southern gate!
Then let us take what men we have and strike while their attack is halted!
Boromir: The Men of Rohan are stout warriors. They will not easily surrender their fortress.
We are close to the postern gate!
Men of Rohan! Defend your homes!
Good! I long for the feeling of solid rock beneath my feet!
We are close to the postern gate!
With me, Men of Rohan! Push these vile invaders out of your city!
Gandalf: We are close to Upbourn! Let us hurry to its southern gate. With luck its garrison has not yet fallen!
We must defend the gate! With me!
These villagers are trapped in their homes! We must clear the wreckage and free them!
Move quickly. We must reach the eastern garrison before they are overrun.
We must rebuild what we can and muster all those that are able to fight. Saruman’s fell horde will return soon.
The forces of Isengard have broken through the outer wall!

Boromir: I fear that Gondor will not survive much longer. Great is my people's need, 
 and that of my father, whose rule is failing.

Gandalf: Denethor is strong, but even he cannot match the will of Sauron. 
 His defences falter. Your brother will be overwhelmed.

Gandalf: Within you lies a portion of my hope for the race of Men. The Ring sought to corrupt you, 
 but it did not prevail. Frodo remains out of Sauron's thought and reach.

Gandalf: Through the pull of the Shadow, you have undergone great change. 
 You are not the same Man that set out from Rivendell, Boromir.
Boromir: What must I do, Mithrandir?

Gandalf: You must set yourself to the stewardship of others. 
 Shield them from that which could not claim you.

Gandalf: Return to Minas Tirith. Take with you both honour and courage. 
 Show your people that there is no storm they cannot weather. No evil they cannot overcome.
Gandalf: Deliver your father from his despair.
Boromir: It is here that we must part, my king.
Aragorn: We will meet again, Boromir.
Gandalf: This is but a taste of the terror that now pours forth from the Ring of Isengard.
Gandalf: Saruman is no mere puppet. His mind has long been set upon the Ring.
Gandalf: I do not doubt that he seeks to overthrow Sauron, only to take his place.
Gandalf: I see now that which I could not before. Long has been his fall. He has forsaken all that he once stood for.

Gandalf: For now, he must reassure the Dark Lord of his loyalty. Through some fell device he has 
 brought about the withering of Rohan. His slow betrayal is revealed at last.

Gandalf: Eomer was the last bulwark against the tide. His banishment is a grave blow. 
 I fear Theoden King has fallen to the whispers of Orthanc.
Aragorn: Then we must set out at once.
Gandalf: Indeed, though I fear the Golden Hall will not receive us gladly.
Aragorn: I do not believe they could withstand the White Wizard.
Gandalf: Nor do I. Together we shall cure this evil, and ready Rohan for war.
The Dark Lord sallies forth in
Thorin: Baruk-khazad! The Dwarves are upon you!

strings.ru: Даин: Барук-Кхазад! Гномы. Люди. Эльфы. Мы должны сражаться вместе! За Эребор!

The Highlands of Erebor, formerly known as the Desolation of Smaug, have seen much resettlement in the years since Dain Ironfoot ascendance. Rich in metal and minerals, it has once again become the heartland of the kingdom of Durin's Folk.
